title: Virtual Assistant & Social Media Content Creator
description:
About Sacred Circle Counseling and Consulting

Sacred Circle Counseling and Consulting provides compassionate, holistic, and trauma-informed mental health services and professional consulting. We are dedicated to promoting mental health awareness, wellness, and self-discovery. We are looking for a motivated self-starter to join our team in a part-time capacity to elevate our presence on Instagram and connect meaningfully with our community.



Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, self-motivated Virtual Assistant for a part-time remote position. In this role, you will focus on content creation, short-form video editing, and engaging storytelling. You will take educational wellness concepts and transform them into engaging, aesthetically pleasing Instagram posts, Reels, and graphics that promote emotional well-being and market our practice's services.



Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Creation:



Conceptualize, design, and write captions for engaging Instagram posts, carousels, and stories centered around mental health, wellness, and self-care.



Translate complex therapeutic and wellness concepts into accessible, inspirational, and actionable content.



Maintain a consistent brand voice, aesthetic tone, and visual style aligned with Sacred Circle Counseling and Consulting.



Video Editing & Production:



Edit raw video footage into polished short-form video content (Instagram Reels) using tools like CapCut, Canva, or mobile video editing software.



Add captions/subtitles, trending audio, visual transitions, and graphic overlays to boost engagement.



Social Media Management & Growth:



Schedule and publish posts according to a content calendar.



Write engaging copy, clear calls-to-action (CTAs), and relevant hashtags to drive reach and engagement.



Monitor engagement, respond to comments/DMs, and help foster an active, supportive online community.



Qualifications & Requirements

Digital Portfolio Required: A link to an online portfolio, website, or sample drive demonstrating previous social media graphics and short-form video editing work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Experience: Proven track record of creating social media content (specifically for Instagram) and editing short-form videos.



Self-Starter Mindset: Highly motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently to turn ideas and wellness concepts into finished posts with minimal supervision.



Video Editing Skills: Proficiency with video editing applications (CapCut, InShot, Canva, etc.).



Strong Copywriting: Excellent written communication with the ability to convey empathy, clarity, and professionalism while maintaining an engaging tone.



Interest in Wellness: A genuine passion or background interest in mental health, wellness, personal growth, and self-care.



Position Details & Compensation

Employment Type: Part-Time (Contract)



Hours: Flexible part-time hours (approx. 5–15 hours per week).



Location: 100% Remote (International candidates welcome).



Compensation: $4.00 per hour.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a link to your digital portfolio showcasing your short-form video editing work and social media posts.

title: Short-Form Reels Editor (Personal Brand)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I'm building my personal brand on Instagram and TikTok, and I'm looking for one editor to team up with me on it for the long haul. If you love short-form content, you're fast, and you want to grow with someone instead of bouncing between gigs, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Instagram Reels and TikToks. Talking-head "yapping" videos, get-ready-with-me, and day-in-the-life.

- How many: About one reel a day to start, with room to grow to two.

- Pay: $10–$20 per reel based on experience and quality, with raises as we grow.

- Turnaround: 24 hours from raw footage to first cut.

- Tools: Instagram Edits app ideally, CapCut works too. We'll work in Slack.

- My page: 



ABOUT THE BRAND



My personal page is where I share the real stuff: my thoughts, my mornings, the gym, the grind of building something while working full-time. Raw, real, and consistent. Also make fitness content here. 



This is a brand-new push. I'm committing to posting every single day, and I need an editing partner who's just as committed. I don't need you to be a 10-year pro. I need someone with a good eye, real short-form experience, and the hunger to get great. I'll train you on exactly how I want things edited (I have a full style guide), and once you've got it, you run with it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I'll film and send you raw footage every day through Slack, plus a quick note on the hook and the point of the video. From there:



- Cut it tight. Trim the pauses and rambling, keep the energy up, hook in the first second.

- Captions and on-screen text. Clean, well-timed, in our brand style. This is a big part of the look.

- Simple, tasteful edits. Zooms, cuts, B-roll placement, sound. Enough to hold attention, never overdone.

- Two styles: raw talking-head yapping reels, and GRWM or day-in-the-life vlogs with timestamps and title cards.

- Export ready-to-post, 9:16, so I can post to Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

- Quick tweaks from my notes. Usually one round, often none.



THE STANDARD



Go look at these before you apply so we're on the same page:




 (super engaging, feels real, great pacing)


 (clean lifestyle and GRWM style)


 (raw, personality-first talking-head content)


 (the golden example for raw yapping reels. Our style guide is built around this.)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit like that, and I'd love to," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited short-form content before (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts) and you can show me examples. Doesn't have to be for a big account.

- You know the Instagram Edits app, or you're strong in CapCut. Either works, Edits is a plus.

- You're passionate about short-form. You watch Reels and notice why they work. You have opinions on hooks and pacing.

- You're comfortable in Slack and you're responsive. We'll talk every day.

- Fast and reliable. 24-hour turnarounds, and if something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable. I'll train you on my style and give clear feedback, and you actually apply it.

- Fluent English, and you get the vibe of lifestyle and self-improvement content.



Please don't apply if you're looking for a quick one-off gig. This is a daily, long-term thing and I want someone who's excited about that.



WHAT YOU GET



- Daily, consistent work. Around 30 reels a month would be the goal.

- Raises as your work speaks for itself. When the page grows, you grow with it.

- Real training. You'll get my full style guide and direct feedback from me. You'll leave this a much better editor than you came in.

- Room to grow. There's a long-form YouTube channel and a startup behind this too. As it all takes off, there's a lot more to make, and you get first look.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on hooks, trends, and what to try next. You're a creative partner, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Sunrise" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3–5 Reels or TikToks you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which editing app you use, and whether you've used Instagram Edits.

3. One reel from any of the accounts above and two sentences on why it works.

4. Your rate per reel and how many reels a week you can realistically handle.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit, one real reel from real footage, before we commit. So you get paid either way.



I need to see your work to consider you, so please don't skip the links. Excited to see what you've made and hopefully build this together!



— Giovanni

title: Direct Response Video Editor for E-Commerce Brands (Meta Ads)
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled and reliable video editor who understands video ad creatives for e-commerce brands. Specifically Meta/Facebook ads that are built to convert.

You should already have experience creating high-performing ad creatives such as:

* AI voiceover ads

* AI UGC-style ads

* Turning scripts, hooks, and raw assets into compelling conversion-focused ads

* Producing multiple creative variations and iterations quickly

* Collaborating with our team on ad concepts, messaging angles, and creative improvements

* Maintaining organized project files and efficient turnaround times

* Communicating daily regarding progress, updates, and deliverables

* Proven experience creating direct response video ads for e-commerce brands

* Strong understanding of Meta ad creative best practices

* Experience using:

* ElevenLabs

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* High proficiency with editing software such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, Final Cut, or similar

* Sourcing clips from social media to use for B-Roll

* Strong English communication skills

* Fast turnaround times and responsiveness

* Ability to follow creative direction while also bringing new ideas proactively

* Detail-oriented with a high standard for quality control



Bonus Points:

* Experience scaling winning ad creatives

* Copywriting instincts for ad scripting and hooks

* List of 3 brands that you’ve edited for

* A short paragraph explaining why you’re a great fit

* Include the word “pineapple” somewhere in your application so we know you read the full posting

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 and Instagram advertising campaigns

HOW TO APPLY

We are looking for one smart, honest and dependable person who wants to understand our business, improve the numbers and become an important long-term member of it.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to handle customer inquiries, build strong relationships with homeowners, and turn service inquiries into booked appointments. This role combines customer service, consultative sales, and scheduling coordination, requiring someone who can confidently communicate with customers, handle objections, gather accurate job details, and manage opportunities through the sales pipeline. The ideal candidate is highly organized, sales-driven, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced U.S. home services environment.



Key Responsibilities:

• Answer and manage a high volume of inbound customer calls,
s, and service inquiries.

• Quickly establish rapport and build trust with homeowners.

• Use a consultative sales approach to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate services.

• Gather accurate and complete job details, including property information, scope of work, customer concerns, photos, timelines, and other relevant details.

• Convert inquiries and customer conversations into booked appointments and services.

• Clearly explain services, pricing, estimates, scheduling, and next steps in a transparent and professional manner.

• Handle customer objections confidently and professionally while working toward a successful booking.

• Follow up consistently with customers who have pending estimates, unbooked proposals, or incomplete inquiries.

• Manage the sales pipeline and ensure no opportunities fall through the cracks.

• Coordinate and optimize schedules for field technicians and sales estimators.

• Communicate with field teams to ensure appointments are properly scheduled and dispatched.

• Adjust schedules efficiently when cancellations, delays, or changes occur.

• Maintain accurate customer records and notes in scheduling/CRM software.

• Respond quickly to customer inquiries and minimize delays between initial contact and scheduling.

• Maintain a smooth, natural conversation without awkward pauses or unnecessary delays.

• Learn from mistakes, apply feedback, and continuously improve sales and customer service performance.

• Follow company processes while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and conversion rates.



Qualifications & Requirements:

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Clear, confident, and professional speaking voice.

• Strong sales background, preferably with aggressive/goal-oriented sales experience.

• Previous experience in home services, contracting, construction, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, restoration, or a similar industry is required.

• Strong consultative selling and objection-handling skills.

• Ability to persuade and close while maintaining a customer-first approach.

• Excellent listening skills and the ability to quickly identify customer needs.

• Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and
s in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong understanding of U.S. geography, including states, major cities, regions, and time zones.

• Strong computer skills and the ability to quickly learn and use CRM, scheduling, dispatch, and other business software.

• Excellent organization and pipeline management skills.

• Strong attention to detail when collecting job information and scheduling appointments.

• Ability to prioritize multiple customers and opportunities simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and stay productive without constant supervision.

• Coachable, accountable, and willing to learn from mistakes and feedback.

• Reliable and able to maintain the required schedule, including weekends.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Please describe your previous experience in the home services, construction, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, restoration, or a similar industry. What type of company did you work for, and what was your role?

2. Tell us about your experience handling customer inquiries and turning those inquiries into booked appointments or sales. What was your process from the initial customer contact to the booking?

title: Video Editor / Cutter for Trading Ads
description:
Video Editor / Cutter – Trading Signals, International



Give you raw footage and a finished script, and you instantly know how to cut it into an ad that performs? That's exactly the eye we're looking for.



About us:

We're one of the largest brokers worldwide and the biggest department in the DACH region – with over 2 million deposits monthly. For our trading signal ads on
, Instagram & more, we're looking for an experienced Video Editor / Cutter, starting immediately, full-time, 40 hours per week.



RESPONSIBILITIES

You'll cut our ad videos for
, Instagram, and other platforms: you'll get raw footage via our Drive along with a finished script from our content team, and turn it into a high-converting video.

You'll remove pauses and use captions, motion graphics, color grading, music, and zooms with intention, so the video hooks viewers from the first second.



If a creator's footage doesn't have suitable B-roll, you'll fill the gap with your own motion graphics.

You won't just be editing English videos, but international ones – including Polish, Italian, and German and more. You don't need to speak these languages, but you should be able to work carefully with foreign-language scripts and subtitles.

Speed is critical for us: we currently run up to 10 ads daily whenever material is ready to cut. In total, we're producing around 150–200 videos per month.

You'll work closely with our content team, who provides you with concept, script, and footage – the final polish in the edit is on you.



QUALIFICATIONS

You've already edited high-quality video ads, ideally in the trading or finance niche. Please send us a few examples of your previous work directly with your application (e.g., a Drive link or portfolio link).

You're skilled in motion graphics, to make up for missing B-roll material.

You're reliable, stick to agreements and deadlines, and respond promptly.

You communicate clearly and without friction – we don't want to have to explain things twice to get on the same page.



WHAT WE OFFER

A full-time position with long-term collaboration, if it's a good fit on both sides.

Clear scripts and concepts from our content team – you won't have to come up with concepts yourself, just execute the edit.

Direct, straightforward communication and short turnaround on decisions.

Above-average pay – a reliable, long-term team matters to us, and that's reflected in the compensation.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send us a few examples of your previous work directly with your application (ideally creatives from the trading niche), along with one or two sentences about yourself. We review every application with a portfolio and get back to you promptly.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Web Designer
description:
# Web Designer & Developer + Logo Designer Needed for U.S.-Based Company



**Project: Professional Corporate Website + Logo**



We are looking for an experienced **Web Designer / Web Developer** who can also create a professional logo for our U.S.-based company, **Ironvia Global LLC**.



This is a **small but high-quality branding and website project**.



We need:

We are NOT looking for an e-commerce store or a large, complicated website.



Our main goal is to establish Ironvia Global LLC as a **serious, trustworthy and professional business partner** when brands, manufacturers, distributors and other companies research us online.



---



# ABOUT IRONVIA GLOBAL LLC



Ironvia Global LLC is a U.S.-based company focused on **Brand Direct Wholesale** and building long-term partnerships with brands.



We develop wholesale and distribution opportunities across major e-commerce marketplaces and other sales channels.



Our website is primarily a **corporate credibility and business development website**.



We want potential business partners to visit our website and immediately understand that Ironvia is a professional company interested in building **long-term business relationships**.



---



# THE PROJECT



We need a simple, modern and premium-looking **2–3 page corporate website**, together with a professional logo.



The website should communicate:



* Who Ironvia is

* What we do

* Our Brand Direct Wholesale business model

* Why brands should consider working with us

* Our approach to partnerships

* How potential partners can contact us



The overall impression should be:



**Professional | Modern | Trustworthy | International | Premium | B2B**



We prefer a minimalist and sophisticated design rather than a complicated website with many animations, pages or unnecessary features.



---



# LOGO DESIGN — INCLUDED



Ironvia Global LLC also needs a professional logo.



The logo should fit the company's positioning as a **U.S.-based B2B wholesale and brand partnership company**.



We are looking for a logo that is:



* Clean

* Modern

* Professional

* Timeless

* Easy to recognize

* Suitable for a global B2B company



We do NOT need a large branding package.



We need a strong and professional **company logo / wordmark** that can be used for:



* Website

*
 signature

* Business documents

* Social media

* Future marketing materials



### Logo Deliverables



The final logo should include:



* Primary logo

* Horizontal/standard version if appropriate

* Transparent background version

* High-resolution PNG

* SVG/vector format

* Black/white version

* Editable/source file



---



# WEBSITE STRUCTURE



## PAGE 1 — HOME



The homepage will be the primary presentation of Ironvia.



Suggested sections:



### Hero



A strong headline such as:



**Strategic Wholesale Partnerships for Global Brands**



Short supporting text explaining what Ironvia does.



Primary CTA:



**Partner With Us**



### What We Do



A short overview of:



* Brand Direct Wholesale

* Wholesale Distribution

* Marketplace Channel Development

* International Business Partnerships



This section should be concise and visually clean.



### Why Partner With Ironvia



A few clear points explaining our value:



* Long-term partnerships

* Professional wholesale operations

* Multiple sales channel opportunities

* Sustainable business growth

* Reliable business relationships



### Our Approach



A simple visual or text-based process:



**Partnership → Distribution → Growth**



Keep this section simple and elegant.



### Final CTA



Example:



**Interested in partnering with Ironvia?**



Button:



**Contact Us**



---



# PAGE 2 — ABOUT / OUR BUSINESS



A short and professional presentation of Ironvia Global LLC.



This page should explain:



* Who we are

* Our business model

* Brand partnerships

* Wholesale distribution

* Our long-term approach



We do NOT need a long company history.



The content should be concise and professional.



---



# PAGE 3 — CONTACT / PARTNERSHIPS



A simple B2B contact page.



Suggested headline:



**Let's Build a Partnership**



Short text inviting brands and businesses to contact Ironvia.



Contact form:



* Name

* Company

* Business

* Company Website

* Message



The purpose of the form is to generate **B2B partnership inquiries**.



---



# VERY IMPORTANT — THIS IS NOT AN E-COMMERCE WEBSITE



Please understand this before applying.



There will be:



❌ No shopping cart

❌ No checkout

❌ No payment system

❌ No consumer sales

❌ No product catalog

❌ No product category pages

❌ No customer account system



This is a **corporate B2B website**.



The primary purpose is to establish credibility and generate business relationships.



Ironvia may work with Amazon and other major e-commerce marketplaces, but the website should NOT look like an Amazon seller website.



The positioning should remain broader:



**Brand Partnerships + Wholesale Distribution + Global Business Development**



---



# DESIGN STYLE



We want a **premium, minimalist corporate design**.



The website should feel like a professional U.S.-based international company.



Think:



**Modern American Corporate + International B2B + Premium Wholesale**



We want:



* Excellent typography

* Good spacing

* Strong visual hierarchy

* High-quality imagery

* Clean navigation

* Professional use of color

* Subtle and tasteful animations only where useful

* Excellent desktop and mobile experience



Please avoid:



* Cheap-looking templates

* Generic dropshipping aesthetics

* Excessive animations

* Overly colorful designs

* Crowded layouts

* Unnecessary sections

* Stock-photo-heavy designs



A simple website can look extremely premium when the design is done correctly.



---



# PLATFORM

WordPress, Webflow, Framer or another suitable platform are acceptable.

* Final logo variations

* Vector/source files

* Basic black/white version



### Website

* Contact form

* Payment gateway

* Custom web applications

* Advanced animations

* Complex integrations

* Large CMS/database systems

* Full SEO campaigns

* Ongoing content creation

* Professional photography

* Full brand identity package

* Social media management



If you believe an additional feature is important, please mention it in your proposal before starting.



---



# CONTENT

You should be able to turn our information into **clear and professional website copy/layout**.



We are looking for concise B2B messaging.



We do not need long pages filled with unnecessary text.



The website should communicate our value quickly and professionally.



---



# DELIVERABLES



At the end of the project, we expect:

* Final logo files

* SVG/vector

* PNG

* Transparent version

* Black/white version

* Editable/source file



### Website



* Fully functional 2–3 page website

* Responsive mobile version

* Working contact form

* Basic SEO setup

* Basic speed optimization

* All agreed revisions completed

* Website ready for launch

* Website/admin access transferred to us



If Figma is used, please provide the final Figma design as well.



---



# TIMELINE



Please provide your estimated completion time in your proposal.



We are more interested in **quality than rushing the project**, but we expect consistent communication and progress throughout the project.



---



# PRICE / QUOTE



**We are intentionally not specifying a budget for this project.**



Please review the complete project requirements and provide your **best fixed-price quotation** for the complete project, including:



**Logo design + 2–3 page website**



Please clearly state:



**Your total project price: $___ USD**

* Portfolio quality

* Design quality

* Understanding of our business

* Communication

* Proposed platform

* Timeline

* Overall value

* Price



We are not necessarily looking for the cheapest proposal.



We are looking for the **best overall value and quality**.



---



# PAYMENT



Payment will be divided into reasonable project milestones.



For example:



**Milestone 1 — Logo & Initial Design**



**Milestone 2 — Website Development**



**Milestone 3 — Final Revisions & Launch**

We will not require the freelancer to complete the entire project before receiving any payment.



---



# WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who:



* Has a strong eye for modern design

* Can create professional corporate websites

* Can design a professional logo

---



# PORTFOLIO IS VERY IMPORTANT

Please send:



**3–5 websites you personally designed/developed**



and



**2–3 logos/branding projects you personally created**

Prior authorization experience

We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term position who can become an important part of our practice and take ownership of the billing workflow.

title: Authorization Coordinator Assistant
description:
We are a leading healthcare organization committed to providing exceptional patient care and improving the health and well-being of our communities. As a Remote Authorization Department Associate, you will play a crucial role in ensuring timely and accurate authorizations for our patients, enabling them to access the care they need.



**Responsibilities:**



As a Remote Authorization Department Associate, you will be responsible for handling various tasks related to authorizations and communicating with regional managing partners and clinicians via our communication platforms. Your primary duties will include:



1. **Answering Incoming Phone Calls:** Respond to incoming phone calls promptly and professionally, addressing inquiries related to authorizations, status updates, and general information regarding the department's processes.



2. **Follow-up Phone Calls:** Initiate follow-up phone calls on requested authorizations already in process. Communicate with patients, insurance companies, and healthcare providers to ensure smooth processing and timely approval of authorizations.



3. **Requesting New Authorizations:** Initiate and manage the process of obtaining new authorizations from insurance companies or relevant parties for upcoming patient treatments, or services.



4. **Tracking Authorization Expiration Dates:** Maintain a meticulous record of all current authorizations and their expiration dates. Proactively work to renew authorizations before they lapse, ensuring continuous patient care.



5. **Communication with Regional Managing Partners and Clinicians:** Collaborate with regional managing partners and clinicians to keep them informed about the approval or denial status of patient authorizations. Provide necessary updates and coordinate solutions in case of denials.



6. **Documentation and Data Entry:** Accurately document all communication, actions taken and relevant information related to authorizations in the department's database or electronic health records system.



7. **Adherence to Compliance:** Follow strict protocols and guidelines to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements regarding patient privacy and authorization processes.



8. **Process Improvement:** Continuously identify opportunities to streamline and improve the authorization process, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the department.



**Qualifications:**



- High school diploma or equivalent; some college coursework in healthcare administration or related fields is a plus.

- Previous experience in a healthcare authorization department or related administrative role is preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

- Proficiency in using computer systems, databases, and google suite applications.

- Detail-oriented and organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to handle inquiries and concerns in a compassionate and professional manner.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders.



**Remote Work Requirements:**



This position is fully remote, requiring a reliable internet connection and a quiet, dedicated workspace to ensure efficient communication and execution of responsibilities.

Position to be worked Monday - Friday (8am - 5pm Eastern US Time Zone)

title: TikTok Shop Manager — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a fast growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



A growing CPG food brand is looking for a TikTok Shop Manager to build and run our TikTok Shop storefront from the ground up. Everything that turns our existing TikTok following into TikTok Shop sales — this is a high-impact role for someone who understands both the TikTok Shop platform and how to sell a food/CPG product.



What you'll do:

- Set up and continuously optimize our TikTok Shop product catalog — titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and categories for each product variant

- Recruit, onboard, and manage affiliate creators through TikTok's Creator Marketplace/affiliate program to promote our products in exchange for commission, growing our reach beyond our own account

- Plan and coordinate livestream shopping events (LIVE selling), including scheduling hosts, prepping talking points, and promoting the stream in advance

- Set up and manage TikTok Shop ads (Shop Ads / GMV Max) and promotional tools — vouchers, flash sales, bundle deals — to drive conversions

- Monitor TikTok Shop analytics (views, click-through, conversion rate, GMV) and report weekly on what's working, with recommendations to improve

- Keep inventory, pricing, and order fulfillment in sync between TikTok Shop and our online store

- Handle TikTok Shop customer questions, reviews, and any order issues

- Stay current on TikTok Shop policy, algorithm, and feature changes and flag anything that affects our strategy

- Work with our content creator to make sure videos link to the right products and use TikTok Shop's shoppable video/showcase features



Why this role matters:

TikTok Shop turns our existing audience (already posting 3–5 videos per day) directly into a sales channel instead of just brand awareness. A dedicated manager means affiliate creators start promoting us at scale, live selling events convert real-time interest into purchases, and our catalog and ads are actually optimized instead of left on autopilot — all of which should meaningfully grow TikTok-driven revenue.



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience managing a TikTok Shop for a brand — you must provide examples of previous work (e.g., shops you've set up/managed, GMV or affiliate-growth results)

- Familiarity with TikTok's Seller Center, Creator Marketplace, and TikTok Shop ads

- Comfortable with basic e-commerce operations (inventory, order sync, fulfillment coordination)

- Data-comfortable — able to read shop analytics and turn them into a clear action plan

- Strong written English for creator outreach and customer service

- Self-directed; comfortable owning a channel with minimal day-to-day oversight



Nice to have:

- Experience in food, beverage, or CPG brands

- Experience hosting or producing livestream shopping events

- Familiarity with Shopify



Schedule & pay:

title: AI TWIN
description:
AI TWIN + GO HIGH LEVEL AUTOMATION SPECIALIST



Full-Time / Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced AI Automation Specialist / AI Twin Developer** to build an AI version of our founder that can communicate with leads, qualify prospects, follow up, overcome objections, and help generate booked appointments.



This is NOT a basic chatbot position.



We are building a **revenue-generating AI sales and communication system** that should eventually handle conversations at a level that feels extremely close to communicating directly with the founder.



## THE GOAL



Your job is to help us build an AI Twin that can:



* Speak and respond like the founder

* Understand the founder's personality, tone, mindset, and business philosophy

* Handle incoming leads

* Ask intelligent qualifying questions

* Answer FAQs

* Handle common objections

* Follow up with prospects

* Guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Update information inside our CRM

* Trigger automations based on conversations

* Scale the founder's ability to communicate without requiring him to personally answer every message



The AI should sound **confident, direct, conversational, natural, and human — NOT robotic.**



## MUST-HAVE SKILLS



**DO NOT APPLY unless you have real experience with most of the following:**



* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* OpenAI API

* Advanced prompt engineering

* AI agents / AI assistants

* Chatbot development

* AI automation

* GoHighLevel

* CRM workflows

* API integrations

* Webhooks

* Lead qualification systems

* Automated follow-up systems



Experience with the following is a strong plus:



* Claude

* Gemini

* 

* Zapier

* n8n

* Voice AI

* Eleven Labs

* Vapi

* Retell AI

* AI appointment setters



You must also have strong English communication skills.



Your written English must sound **natural and conversational**, not like AI-generated customer service language.



# CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. BUILD THE AI TWIN



This is your primary responsibility.



You will study real material from the founder, including:



* Voice notes

* Text messages

*
s

* Sales conversations

* Call transcripts

* Videos

* Social media content

* FAQs

* Objection-handling conversations

* Business philosophies

* Sales frameworks

* Previous customer conversations



You will identify patterns in how the founder communicates and create a structured AI knowledge system around them.



The AI should learn:



* Vocabulary

* Tone

* Personality

* Humor

* Sentence structure

* Sales style

* Questions the founder asks

* How the founder handles objections

* How the founder motivates prospects

* How the founder closes conversations

* When to push

* When to follow up

* When to qualify someone out

* When to send someone to a human



The goal is NOT simply to give ChatGPT information.



The goal is to create an actual **Founder Communication System.**



## 2. BUILD THE AI KNOWLEDGE BASE



Organize our company knowledge into a system the AI can properly use.



This may include:



* Company information

* Services

* Pricing

* FAQs

* Offers

* Sales scripts

* Objection responses

* Client qualification rules

* Founder philosophy

* Standard operating procedures

* Testimonials

* Case studies

* Lead conversations

* Booking instructions



You must understand how to structure information so the AI retrieves the **correct information at the correct time.**



## 3. GOHIGHLEVEL + CRM INTEGRATION



You will connect the AI Twin with **GoHighLevel** and build automated workflows.



Example:



**New Lead → AI Conversation → Qualification → Follow-Up → Appointment Booking → CRM Update → Human Notification**



You may also build:



*
/Instagram Lead → CRM → AI Response → Qualification → Calendar Booking**



**Website Lead → AI Conversation → Follow-Up → Booking**



**No Response → Automated AI Follow-Up Sequence**



**Missed Appointment → AI Re-Engagement**



**Old Lead → AI Reactivation Campaign**



We want the system working across as many appropriate communication channels as possible.



## 4. AI SALES & LEAD QUALIFICATION



The AI must understand the difference between having a conversation and moving a prospect toward a business outcome.



It should be able to:



* Identify what the prospect needs

* Ask qualifying questions

* Determine whether the prospect is a good fit

* Answer questions

* Handle objections

* Build trust

* Keep conversations moving

* Follow up appropriately

* Book qualified appointments



We will measure this system based on **RESULTS**, not simply how many automations were created.



Important KPIs may include:



* Leads contacted

* Response rate

* Qualified leads

* Appointments booked

* Show rate

* Conversion rate

* Follow-up recovery

* Revenue influenced by AI



# WHO WE WANT



We want somebody who thinks like a **builder and problem solver.**



Do not apply if your main skill is copying prompts from ChatGPT.



We want someone who can look at a business problem and say:



**"Here is how I would build the AI system to solve it."**



You should be comfortable researching solutions independently, testing different approaches, troubleshooting integrations, documenting your work, and continuously improving the system based on real conversations.



# HOW TO APPLY



Your application MUST include all of the following:



### 1. RESUME + PORTFOLIO



Show us AI systems, automations, chatbots, CRM workflows, or similar projects you have actually built.



### 2. VOICE NOTE



Send a **1–2 minute voice recording** introducing yourself.



Tell us:



* Who you are

* Your AI experience

* Your GoHighLevel experience

* Why you believe you can build this system



### 3. RESULTS



Do not only tell us your responsibilities.



Tell us what you produced.



Examples:



* "Built an AI assistant that handled 500+ conversations."

* "Created an automation that increased bookings by 30%."

* "Built an AI appointment setter."

* "Reduced manual follow-up by 70%."

* "Integrated OpenAI with GoHighLevel."



Provide numbers whenever possible.



### 4. TEST TASK



Explain how you would build this system:



**Lead enters GoHighLevel → AI immediately starts conversation → AI qualifies lead → handles basic objections → follows up automatically → qualified prospect books appointment → CRM opportunity is updated → sales team is notified.**



Send us:



* The tools you would use

* How the system would work

* What information you would need from the founder

* How you would train the AI

* How you would prevent incorrect or robotic responses

* How you would continuously improve the AI



You do NOT need to build the entire system for the application.



We want to see **how you think.**



# IMPORTANT



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We are looking for someone who can help us build an AI infrastructure that becomes a serious asset to the company.



The long-term vision is simple:



**The founder should be able to train the system once, and the AI should help communicate, qualify, follow up, and generate appointments 24/7.**



If you cannot build something approaching **human-level business conversations**, this is probably not the right role.



If you understand AI, automation, sales psychology, CRM systems, and how to turn conversations into appointments, we want to hear from you.



**When applying, put "AI TWIN BUILDER" at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job post.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor / TikTok Content Creator/ UGC content — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

title: YouTube Video Editor (Tech & AI)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I run TechGio, a YouTube channel about tech sales, AI, and building a startup. I'm looking for one talented long-form editor to grow the channel with me. If you love clean, premium talking-head content and you're excited about tech and AI, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Long-form YouTube only. Talking-head + screen recordings. No Shorts.

- How many: 2–3 videos a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling)

- Pay: $50–$100 per video based on experience and quality. Roughly $500–$1,000+/month, with raises as your work speaks for itself.

- Turnaround: First cut within 48 hours of getting footage.

- Where: Fully remote. I'm in Houston, Texas. You can be anywhere.

- Channel: 



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own path into tech sales and helping people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that's still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, day-in-the-life.



Now it's growing. I'm going deeper into AI and the tech industry (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for you). And I'm building my own startup on the side, so I'll be sharing the founder journey while working full-time.



I've worked with an editor before and it went great. Now I want more videos, more polish, and one editor who becomes a true long-term partner. Someone who grows with the channel and wins when it wins. Hopefully that's you!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film. You get raw footage (Sony A7 IV), screen recordings, and a short brief with the hook, structure, and the moments I want to hit. Then you run the edit:



- Cut it tight. Trim dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the whole game.

- On-screen text and captions. Callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed. This is a big part of the style.

- Simple, polished motion. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool and UI highlights, clean transitions. Think Jeff Su, not MrBeast.

- Screen recording polish. Zooms, cursor highlights, blur anything sensitive.

- Music, sound design, and clean dialogue audio.

- Color, final export, and organized project files.

- Quick revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



THE STANDARD



Watch a couple of these before you apply so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example: clean, tight, sharp text, subtle motion, never overdone)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (clear diagrams and callouts that make AI simple)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong pacing, premium feel)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit at that level," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited long-form YouTube talking-head content before, ideally for tech, business, or productivity channels, and you have published videos to prove it.

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or similar. You make text and motion look premium.

- You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, the AI features in your editor, whatever works for you. My whole operation runs that way.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows in the edit when the editor cares.

- Fast and reliable. If something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable and hungry. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll work mostly async on Slack or WhatsApp.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started or if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or event videos. Nothing wrong with that work, it's just not this role. I need someone who can hit a high bar from day one.



WHAT YOU GET



- Steady, consistent work. 8–12 videos a month.

- Raises tied to quality. Good work gets rewarded here, I truly mean that.

- Tools covered. Software, plugins, stock music, assets. If you need it to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for it.

- Room to grow. As the channel and the startup take off, there's going to be a lot more to make. You get first look at all of it.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on pacing, hooks, and style. You're a creative partner here, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Mission" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

3. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual first-cut turnaround.

4. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see what you've made and hopefully build something great together!



— Giovanni

title: PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT STRATEGIST & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
Employment Type: Part-Time with Opportunity to Grow

Location: Remote

Platforms: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and portfolio



ABOUT THE ROLE



I am an entrepreneur based in Las Vegas building a personal brand around business, lifestyle, personality and personal evolution.



The central story is about an ambitious entrepreneur who spent years focused on building businesses and is now learning to enjoy the life he worked for—without losing his ambition.



Content will include:



• Behind-the-scenes business moments

• Las Vegas lifestyle and experiences

• Cars, restaurants, travel, fitness and events

• Personal opinions, humor and spontaneous moments

• Honest conversations about success, pressure and personal growth



I am looking for a creative and highly organized Personal Brand Content Strategist and Social Media Manager who can turn my real life, personality and experiences into compelling short-form content.



This is not a basic posting or Canva-graphics position. You must understand personal branding, storytelling, strong hooks and short-form video strategy.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Develop a weekly content strategy based on my personal brand

• Create short-form video concepts for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Write strong hooks, talking prompts, captions and calls to action

• Prepare clear shot lists and filming instructions

• Help me identify moments from my real life that can become content

• Organize raw footage and coordinate with my video editor

• Maintain a consistent visual style, voice and brand identity

• Build and manage a weekly content calendar

• Schedule and publish approved content

• Repurpose strong content across multiple platforms

• Track views, retention, shares, saves, comments and follower growth

• Submit a short weekly performance report with recommendations

• Research relevant trends without allowing trends to dilute the brand

• Proactively suggest improvements based on performance



THE BRAND DIRECTION



The brand should feel:



• Cinematic

• Ambitious

• Authentic

• Confident

• Unpredictable

• Aspirational but still relatable



The content should combine polished lifestyle footage with raw, personality-driven moments. The goal is not to create a fake “guru” or luxury influencer. The goal is to build a recognizable world around a real entrepreneur and an unfolding personal journey.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Proven experience managing a personal brand or creator account

• Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Excellent English writing and communication skills

• Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling and audience retention

• Able to turn ordinary daily moments into interesting content

• Creative, organized and comfortable taking initiative

• Able to study analytics and make strategic adjustments

• Understands the difference between building a brand and chasing views

• Comfortable collaborating with a founder and video editor

• Interested in business, lifestyle and personality-based content



Video-editing experience is helpful but not required. This position is primarily focused on strategy, planning, organization, publishing and growth.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



During the first 30 days, we should:



• Establish a consistent personal-brand identity

• Build a repeatable weekly filming and publishing system

• Publish approximately 12–20 quality short-form videos

• Identify the strongest content themes, hooks and formats

• Reduce the amount of daily planning required from me

• Create a clear strategy based on actual performance data



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. A brief explanation of your experience managing personal brands

2. Links to three accounts or projects you have worked on

3. Five short-form videos you helped plan, write or manage

4. A clear explanation of your role in those results

5. The metrics you use to evaluate short-form content

6. Your expected monthly salary for part-time work

7. Your availability and preferred working hours



Text me on whats app for quicker response

What you'll do:

- Take dielines supplied by our pouch/packaging manufacturer and build or update packaging artwork to fit them exactly

- Update existing packaging files (Adobe Illustrator/.ai) when details change — new flavors/variants, updated copy, ingredient or nutrition panel changes, barcodes, certifications, or retailer-specific requirements

- Prepare final files to print specifications: correct bleed, safe zones, CMYK/Pantone color matching, resolution, and file structure per the manufacturer's requirements

- Create new packaging designs for new product launches, working within our existing brand guidelines (colors, logo, fonts, layout style)

- Resize or adapt existing designs across different pouch sizes/formats as needed

- Keep packaging files organized and version-controlled by SKU/flavor so past versions are easy to find

- Communicate directly with our pouch manufacturer/printer as needed to resolve dieline questions or proof issues

- Flag any inconsistencies across our SKUs and help keep packaging visually consistent brand-wide



Why this role matters:

Packaging changes and new flavor launches currently depend on the founder's own limited design time, which slows things down and risks inconsistency across SKUs. A dedicated designer who's fluent in dielines and print production means new flavors and packaging updates can move faster, print-ready files go to the manufacturer with fewer errors or delays, and the brand looks consistent and professional across every product on the shelf.



What we're looking for:

- Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, specifically working from manufacturer-supplied dielines

- Understanding of print production requirements: bleed, safe zone, CMYK/Pantone color, resolution, packaging file structure

- Experience with flexible packaging/pouch design specifically is a strong plus (not just general graphic design)

- Sharp attention to detail — small errors in packaging artwork are costly to fix once printed

- Comfortable taking direction and revising designs based on feedback

- Good written English for communicating with our team and, when needed, our manufacturer

- You must provide examples of previous packaging design work (please include links or files/images we can view without needing special software)



Nice to have:

- Experience designing for food or beverage CPG packaging specifically

- Familiarity with common pouch/bag formats (stand-up pouches, flat-bottom bags, etc.)

- Basic knowledge of nutrition facts panel or ingredient label formatting requirements



Schedule & pay:

Gig work, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately  $4.50/hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver and when packaging changes warrant 



To apply:

Please share 2–3 examples of packaging or dieline-based design work you've done (images or view-only links are fine — please avoid sending files that require downloading or special software to open). Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

Self-motivated, organized, persistent, goal-oriented and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

What We Offer

• Full-time, 100% remote position

title: CLEANING SERVICE REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR (MALE PREFERRED)
description:
# REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR



**Company:** thenycmaid  

**Location:** Remote  

**Starting Pay:** $250 USD/week  

**Pay:** Weekly or daily automatic payments available  

**Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time  

**Openings:** 2  

**Start:** Immediately / Ready to start Monday



## 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



**DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT AN INTRODUCTION VIDEO.**



Applications without the requested video will not be reviewed.



---



# ABOUT THENYCMAID



thenycmaid is an established and growing cleaning service serving New York City.



This is not a startup trying to figure out how to find customers.



Our business currently:



- Generates approximately **5–10 new organic leads every day**

- Operates a network of **100+ websites**

- Generates business organically without relying on paid advertising

- Has earned **100+ Google reviews**

- Works with approximately **10 cleaners**, with plans to significantly expand our cleaner roster

- Recently completed **200+ cleaning services in a single month for the first time**

- Historically closes approximately **80% of qualified leads**



Our operation is heavily automated through **Full Loop CRM**, and we're looking for people who can oversee that system, provide excellent customer service, solve problems, and help us continue growing.



**Previous cleaning-service industry experience is required.**



# THE POSITIONS



We are hiring **two people**.



### Weekday Position



**Monday – Friday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



### Weekend Position



**Saturday – Sunday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



Please clearly indicate which schedule you are applying for.



# WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS



This isn't a traditional receptionist position where you simply answer a telephone.



You will essentially be the **human operator overseeing an automated cleaning-service system**.



Our technology handles much of the repetitive work automatically.



Your responsibility is to **monitor the operation, communicate with customers and cleaners, and step in when human attention is required.**



# HOW OUR AUTOMATED SYSTEM WORKS



Our normal workflow looks like this:



**1. A lead comes in organically.**



We currently receive approximately 5–10 new leads per day.



**2. The system processes the lead.**



Bookings and jobs move through Full Loop CRM.



**3. Jobs are automatically assigned to cleaners.**



Our cleaners have their own portals where they manage their assigned work.



**4. Cleaners receive notifications about upcoming jobs.**



They receive a 30-minute notice before their scheduled service.



**5. Cleaners check in and check out through their portals.**



**6. Customer payments are collected automatically.**



**7. Cleaner payments are processed automatically.**



**8. Review requests and customer follow-ups are automated.**



When automation isn't enough, **you step in.**



Your job is to keep an eye on the entire operation and make sure things are running correctly.



# YOUR COMMAND CENTER: COMHUB



Most of your working day will be spent inside **ComHub**.



ComHub brings all of our incoming communications into one place:



- Phone calls

-
s

- Text messages

- Website chats



You will stay logged into ComHub throughout your shift and actively monitor incoming communications.



## 60-SECOND RESPONSE STANDARD



Our goal is simple:



**Incoming communications should be acknowledged or responded to within 60 seconds whenever reasonably possible.**



You're not expected to completely solve every problem in 60 seconds.



You **are** expected to acknowledge the customer or cleaner quickly and begin handling the situation.



This is not a position where you check messages every 15 minutes.



Monitoring communications **is the job**.



# YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for:



- Answering incoming customer calls

- Responding to texts

- Responding to
s

- Responding to website chats

- Following up with new leads

- Scheduling cleaning services

- Reviewing bookings

- Approving bookings when necessary

- Monitoring automatic job assignments

- Communicating with cleaners

- Handling scheduling changes

- Handling cancellations

- Resolving routine customer concerns

- Resolving routine cleaner issues

- Updating customer and job information

- Monitoring cleaner check-ins and check-outs

- Following up after services

- Helping satisfied customers leave Google reviews

- Helping convert one-time customers into recurring customers

- Identifying problems in the automated workflow

- Taking action when automation requires human assistance

- Helping recruit additional cleaners

- Helping grow and improve the company



# WE WANT PROBLEM SOLVERS



This requirement is extremely important.



**We do not want someone who runs to the boss every time something goes wrong.**



Of course, management is available when something genuinely requires escalation.



But if every minor scheduling issue, customer question, or cleaner problem results in:



**“Boss, what should I do?”**



this will not be a good fit.



We want someone who can:



**Identify the problem → Gather the information → Think → Make a reasonable decision → Solve it.**



As you learn the business, you should become increasingly independent.



We value people whose first thought is:



**“How can I solve this?”**



not:



**“Who can I give this problem to?”**



# CUSTOMER SERVICE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



Fast responses alone aren't enough.



We want customers to feel that they're dealing with a professional company that actually cares about their experience.



That means:



- Being friendly

- Communicating clearly

- Taking ownership

- Solving problems

- Following up

- Keeping customers informed

- Turning unhappy customers into satisfied customers

- Asking satisfied customers for reviews



We don't just want a customer to book once.



Our ideal customer journey is:



**LEAD → BOOKING → GREAT SERVICE → RECURRING CUSTOMER → GREAT REVIEW → REFERRAL**



Your job directly influences that process.



# PERFORMANCE & KPIs



We believe employees should know exactly what success looks like.



You'll have **individual performance standards** as well as **company growth targets**.



## KPI #1 — RESPONSE TIME



**Target: 60 seconds**



Incoming calls, texts,
s, and chats should be acknowledged or responded to within approximately **60 seconds whenever reasonably possible during your active shift**.



## KPI #2 — LEAD CLOSE RATE



**Target: 80%+ of qualified leads**



thenycmaid historically averages approximately an **80% close rate**.



We want to maintain or exceed that.



This doesn't mean aggressively selling people.



It means:



- Answering quickly

- Understanding what the customer needs

- Knowing our services

- Answering questions confidently

- Handling reasonable objections

- Following up

- Making booking easy



When someone contacts us looking for a cleaning service that we can provide, our goal is to turn that opportunity into a booking.



Spam, duplicate inquiries, services we don't provide, out-of-service-area inquiries, and other clearly unqualified contacts do not count as qualified leads.



## KPI #3 — MONTHLY COMPLETED SERVICES



We recently exceeded:



**200 SERVICES/MONTH**



for the first time.



Our current target is:



**225+ SERVICES/MONTH**



Then we'll continue raising the target as the company grows.



This is a company-wide goal rather than something one employee controls alone.



## KPI #4 — RECURRING CUSTOMER RATE



Current:



**~32%**



Target:



**40%+**



We want more customers choosing recurring cleaning services.



When appropriate, you should help customers understand their recurring-service options and follow up with satisfied customers about booking again.



## KPI #5 — AVERAGE TICKET



Previous average:



**~$228**



Recent average:



**~$210**



Target:



**$225+**



Part of the recent decline came from offering customers a $20 review incentive.



We're moving that incentive toward **$10** while continuing to grow our reviews and customer satisfaction.



## KPI #6 — REVIEWS & REPUTATION



We already have **100+ Google reviews**.



We want that number to keep growing.



Satisfied customers should be encouraged to share their experience.



We care about both:



**Quantity of reviews AND quality of customer experience.**



## KPI #7 — ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY



Attendance is critical.



This isn't work that can simply wait until tomorrow.



Customers and cleaners are communicating with us in real time.



You must:



- Log in on time

- Be ready to work at the beginning of your shift

- Remain available throughout your shift

- Monitor ComHub consistently

- Communicate immediately if a genuine emergency occurs



Repeated lateness, disappearing during shifts, or regularly missing communications will not work in this position.



## KPI #8 — INDEPENDENT PROBLEM SOLVING



We will also evaluate how effectively you solve normal operational issues **without unnecessarily escalating everything to management**.



As you gain experience, we expect you to become increasingly capable of running day-to-day operations independently.



# BONUSES



We believe people who help grow the company should have opportunities to participate financially in that success.



There will be opportunities for **performance bonuses in addition to base compensation**.



Bonus opportunities may be tied to:



- Maintaining or exceeding an 80% close rate

- Exceeding monthly service targets

- Increasing recurring-service percentage

- Generating positive reviews

- Increasing customer retention

- Improving average ticket

- Recruiting quality cleaners

- Reducing missed opportunities

- Improving operational efficiency

- Creating successful new processes

- Identifying additional revenue opportunities



Our bonus structure will continue evolving as the company grows.



# BRING US IDEAS



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions forever.



We want someone who learns the business and eventually starts noticing things we don't.



If you see something that could improve:



- Customer experience

- Conversion

- Scheduling

- Recurring bookings

- Reviews

- Cleaner recruiting

- Cleaner retention

- Pricing

- Average ticket

- Communication

- Automation

- Efficiency

- Revenue



**Tell us.**



We're open to listening.



Good ideas are valuable.



And when someone's ideas produce measurable results for the company, we're open to rewarding that contribution.



# CLEANER RECRUITING & GROWTH



We currently work with approximately **10 cleaners**, and we're looking to expand.



Part of this position may include helping us:



- Find additional cleaners

- Communicate with applicants

- Screen candidates

- Help with onboarding

- Maintain cleaner information

- Assist cleaners with the system

- Monitor cleaner reliability



As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibility.



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



### Cleaning-Service Experience Is Required



We're specifically looking for someone who already understands the service industry, preferably residential or commercial cleaning.



You should understand situations involving:



- Customers

- Cleaners

- Scheduling

- Rescheduling

- Cancellations

- Late cleaners

- No-shows

- Service complaints

- Quality issues

- Customer expectations

- Reviews

- Recurring services



You must also have **previous customer-service experience**.



Experience involving any of the following is highly valuable:



- Cleaning companies

- Home-service companies

- CRM systems

- Dispatching

- Scheduling

- Reception

- Phone support

- Call centers

- Customer retention

- Sales



Experience with **Full Loop CRM** is a plus.



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable laptop/computer

- Quality headset

- Reliable Wi-Fi/internet connection

- Quiet environment for customer calls

- Reliable access to your equipment throughout your shift



Because this is a live customer-service position, your equipment and internet connection need to be dependable.



# WORK SCHEDULE & LUNCH



Working hours are:



**8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time**



You may take a:



**30-minute paid lunch break**



We will coordinate coverage so customer communications continue to be monitored.



# COMPENSATION



Starting compensation:



## $250 USD PER WEEK



This is starting compensation—not necessarily where we expect a strong employee to remain.



When we see someone succeeding, taking ownership, becoming independent, and helping grow the company, we're comfortable increasing compensation.



Raises are commonly:



**+$50 to +$100 per week**



as we see successful performance.



And we're comfortable going higher from there as someone's responsibilities and contribution increase.



**Performance bonuses are additional.**



# PAYMENT



Payments are handled automatically through **Stripe**.



You'll receive a secure link where you enter your name and Philippine banking information.



Payments are automatically issued:



**Every Thursday**



In most cases, funds are received by:



**Friday**



If you prefer to receive your compensation **daily instead of weekly**, automatic daily payment can also be arranged.



# APPLICANT PREFERENCE



**Male applicants are preferred for this opening.**



Qualified applicants will ultimately be evaluated based on their experience, communication skills, reliability, problem-solving ability, customer-service skills, and ability to perform the position successfully.



# 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



**WE WILL ONLY REVIEW APPLICANTS WHO SUBMIT THE REQUIRED INTRODUCTION VIDEO.**



No video = no interview.



Your video does NOT need:



- Professional editing

- Special lighting

- Fancy equipment

- Professional production



A normal phone or webcam recording is perfectly acceptable.



We want to see **you**.



## In Your Video, Answer ALL of the Following:



**1. Introduce yourself.**



Tell us your name and where you're located.



**2. Tell us about your previous work experience.**



**3. Describe your cleaning-service experience.**



Be specific about the company, your responsibilities, and what you actually did.



**4. Describe your customer-service experience.**



**5. Tell us about your experience answering customer phone calls.**



**6. Tell us about any CRM, scheduling, dispatching, or booking systems you've used.**



**7. Tell us about a time you had a problem at work and solved it yourself instead of immediately asking your manager what to do.**



**8. Tell us why you believe you'd be successful in this position.**



**9. Tell us whether you're applying for:**



**WEEKDAY — Monday through Friday**



or



**WEEKEND — Saturday and Sunday**



**10. Confirm that you can consistently work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time.**



# VIDEO SCENARIO #1 — ANGRY CUSTOMER



Pretend we're the customer.



A customer calls and says:



**“My cleaner was supposed to arrive 20 minutes ago. Nobody is here. What's going on?”**



The customer is frustrated.



**Show us exactly how you would respond to that customer.**



Don't tell us what customer service means.



**Show us.**



# VIDEO SCENARIO #2 — CLEANER CANCELLATION



A cleaner contacts you and says:



**“I can't make it to my next job.”**



The customer is expecting someone shortly.



Explain:



**Exactly what would you do next?**



Walk us through your thought process.



# VIDEO SCENARIO #3 — SALES / BOOKING



A potential customer contacts us and says:



**“I'm comparing a few cleaning companies and haven't d
 who I'm going to use yet.”**



Show us how you would handle the conversation and attempt to turn that lead into a booking **without being pushy or unprofessional**.



# WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY TESTING



The introduction video allows us to evaluate:

- Communication

- Confidence

- Professionalism

# HOW TO APPLY

**✓ Confirmation that you are available to begin promptly**



# APPLICATION TITLE



Use exactly one of the following:



**NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKDAY**



or



**NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKEND**



This is also an attention-to-detail test.



If you can't follow the application instructions, this probably isn't the right position for you.



# WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE?



You'll probably do very well here if you're someone who:



- Shows up

- Shows up on time

- Communicates clearly

- Likes helping customers

- Thinks independently

description:
We built an AI bot that negotiates with clothing suppliers on behalf of buyers. It handles the back-and-forth on price, MOQ, samples, and lead times. Your job: be the human quality check on every conversation.

- Read live negotiation conversations between our bot and clothing suppliers

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Real experience negotiating with suppliers (Alibaba/1688, garment or apparel sourcing is a big plus)

- Excellent written English - you can instantly judge tone, clarity, and whether a message will land

- You know sourcing basics: unit price, MOQ, sampling, lead times, shipping terms

- Comfortable with chat tools and simple dashboards



DETAILS

- Part-time to start (about 20 hrs/week), can grow into full-time as volume grows

- Paid hourly, rate based on experience



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words FINAL CHECK so we know you read this. Then briefly describe one supplier negotiation you personally handled: the product, what you negotiated, and the result.

title: Automation / Data Engineer (Part-Time) — Build a Lead Enrichment Engine
description:
We run a B2B lead generation pipeline built on public business filing data. Records come in on an automated pull, get scored and tiered, and route to our sales team through  CRM.



The problem: contact enrichment is still manual. Two people research each record by hand to find phone numbers and
s, and they can't keep pace with volume. Our highest-value records go stale before anyone touches them.



Your job is to make that step disappear.



This is a build project first, with ongoing part-time work maintaining and extending the system afterward if it goes well.



What you'll build



Automated enrichment. Integrate third-party data APIs to resolve contact information without human involvement. Includes deduplication and caching so we never pay twice for the same lookup, phone line type validation, and fallback logic when a lookup fails.



Automated lead scoring. Our raw data contains signals we aren't currently computing. You'll derive them at ingest and build them into a scoring model that runs on every record automatically. I need to be able to adjust scoring weights myself without asking you for a code change.



Prioritized review queue. Records that fail automated lookup go to a human queue, ordered by record value and freshness rather than first in first out.



Monitoring and alerting. This matters as much as the build. The system runs unattended against paid APIs and feeds a queue our sales team depends on. I need failure alerts, spend anomaly alerts, rate limit handling with backoff, and retry logic that doesn't duplicate paid lookups. A silent failure costs real money.



Documentation. A deliverable, not an afterthought. System documentation, a runbook for common failures, and a walkthrough where I can demonstrate I understand how to operate it. I built the current pipeline myself and I'm not willing to end up unable to troubleshoot my own system.



Required

Strong Python, or n8n plus Python

Real experience integrating third-party APIs, including handling rate limits, pagination, retries, and auth

Experience working with large volumes of messy record data: deduplication, normalization, fuzzy matching on names and addresses

A database background (PostgreSQL or similar)

You've built something that ran unattended in production and you know what it takes to keep it running

Clear English



Nice to have

Google Apps Script and Google Sheets API

Close CRM or comparable CRM APIs

Experience with skip trace, identity, or B2B contact enrichment vendors

Dashboarding (Looker Studio, Metabase, or similar)

Any background in lending, MCA, fintech.
