title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA / Wholesaling Operator – Cold Calling & Lead Research
description:
Five Pillars Real Estate Investors is looking for an experienced, dependable Real Estate Acquisitions Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.



We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on identifying off-market opportunities, working directly with property owners, and acquiring and wholesaling residential investment properties.



This is NOT simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands real estate lead generation and can eventually become a key part of our acquisitions operation.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Cold call property owners using BatchDialer

• Work and organize lead lists using BatchLeads

• Identify motivated sellers and properly qualify leads

• Ask about motivation, property condition, occupancy, timeline, asking price, and other relevant information

• Consistently follow up with leads and maintain detailed notes

• Research property ownership and public records

• Research County Assessor/Auditor records

• Research County Recorder records

• Research property taxes and delinquent taxes

• Research deeds, ownership transfers, mortgages, liens, probate/inherited-property information, and other publicly available property information

• Use county GIS systems and LandGlide for parcel research

• Research basic property characteristics and zoning when necessary

• Perform preliminary comparable-sales research and assist with ARV analysis

• Skip trace and verify owner contact information

• Identify absentee owners, vacant properties, inherited properties, distressed properties, tax-delinquent properties, and other potential opportunities

• Maintain organized lead records and follow-up tasks

• Build and maintain cash-buyer and investor lists

• Research buyers through public records and previous investor purchases

• Assist with buyer outreach and disposition activities when deals are available

• Prepare concise lead summaries so our acquisitions decision-maker can quickly evaluate opportunities



CURRENT TOOLS



We currently use:



• BatchLeads

• BatchDialer

• LandGlide

ChatGPT

• County assessor/auditor, recorder, tax, court, GIS, and other public-record systems



Experience with additional real estate CRMs, PropStream, REI software, comparable-sales research, skip tracing, title/property research, or wholesaling systems is a plus.



WHO WE WANT



We strongly prefer someone who already has experience working for a U.S. real estate investor, wholesaler, acquisitions company, or similar operation.



You should:



• Speak and write excellent English

• Be comfortable speaking with U.S. property owners by phone

• Understand motivated-seller conversations

• Have strong internet research skills

• Know how to navigate U.S. county property records or be capable of learning different county systems quickly

• Be extremely organized with follow-ups

• Be comfortable learning new software and processes

• Have reliable high-speed internet and a dependable computer

• Be comfortable working hours that overlap with U.S. business hours

• Be interested in a stable, long-term position and growing with the company



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Describe your previous experience working with U.S. real estate investors or wholesalers.



2. Which real estate tools have you personally used? Please specifically mention your experience with BatchLeads, BatchDialer, PropStream, REI CRMs, skip tracing tools, or similar platforms.



3. Have you personally cold called U.S. property owners? Approximately how many calls or conversations did you handle during a normal workday?



4. Walk us through exactly how you would research a distressed property starting with only the property address. Explain how you would determine ownership, property taxes, parcel information, public records, potential liens or mortgages, comparable sales, and owner contact information.



5. Explain how you qualify a motivated seller during a cold call.



6. Tell us about a lead you worked that eventually became a deal, appointment, or qualified opportunity.



7. What hours are you accustomed to working relative to U.S. time zones?



8. Please provide your computer specifications, internet speed, and backup plan if your primary internet connection or electricity fails.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words “FIVE PILLARS” so we know you carefully read the entire posting.



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment before a final interview.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of Five Pillars—not someone looking for another temporary VA assignment.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
Assistant Property Manager

Position Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (with a 30-minute lunch break)

Compensation: $850 – $1,250 USD / month (55,000 – 82,500 PHP)



Remote Work, Monitoring & Accountability

This is a full-time, dedicated remote position with strict accountability standards. Applicants must understand and accept the following requirements before applying:



Exclusive Working Hours: You must devote your full professional attention to SPM during scheduled working hours. Overlapping employment, freelance work, or client work is prohibited.

Time & Activity Monitoring: SPM uses Time Doctor and other administrative systems to monitor attendance, hours worked, activity and idle time, internet connectivity, application and website usage, and productivity.

No Tracking Manipulation: The use of mouse movers, auto-clickers, keyboard simulators, scripts, software, devices, or any other method intended to create artificial activity or misrepresent time worked is strictly prohibited. Intentional manipulation may result in immediate termination.

Reliable Internet: You must maintain dependable internet service throughout your scheduled working hours. Technical or connectivity issues must be reported promptly. Repeated or unexplained interruptions that affect attendance or performance will be addressed accordingly.

Performance Expectations: Logged time alone does not demonstrate satisfactory performance. Team members must consistently meet deadlines, KPIs, productivity goals, accuracy standards, and communication requirements.

These requirements are disclosed in the job posting so applicants clearly understand SPM’s remote-work environment before applying for or accepting the position. By applying, you acknowledge that you understand and are prepared to work under these expectations.



The Opportunity:



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Assistant Property Manager to join our dynamic team. Acting as a vital liaison between residents, vendors, clients, and the Property Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations, high tenant satisfaction, and solid financial administration.



If you are a tech-savvy self-starter with a background in real estate operations, property management, accounting, and a passion for providing exceptional service, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities:



Tenant Relations & Leasing

-Serve as the primary point of contact for residents, professionally managing inquiries, maintenance requests, and concerns to maintain high retention rates.

-Support the full leasing cycle, including unit marketing, virtual/in-person property tours, applicant screening, and lease agreement preparation.



Financial & Accounting Operations:

-Manage Accounts Receivable (A/R): Post rent payments, track delinquencies, and coordinate collection efforts.

-Manage Accounts Payable (A/P): Process and code invoices for approval and payment.

-Assist the Property Manager with monthly financial reporting, variance analysis, and annual budget preparation.



Property Operations & Maintenance:

-Coordinate with maintenance teams and external vendors to ensure work orders are executed efficiently and up to standard.

-Conduct regular site walks and property assessments, including move-in and move-out inspections.



Marketing, Media & Executive Support:

-Design visual materials using Canva and assist with basic video editing for property marketing efforts.

-Manage company social media platforms and assist with
 marketing and CRM system updates.

title: APEX Operations Engineer — Internal Systems & DevOps (Sheets/Apps Script, HubSpot, Git)
description:
Read this first: This is an ENTRY-level seat with a real ceiling — not a senior role. Most operations jobs are dead-end. This one isn't. You start running part of our internal systems, and as you prove yourself, you grow into owning the entire internal operating system across all our businesses — and taking DevOps work off our lead engineer. Scope, trust, and pay grow with performance. Our lead engineer walked this exact path here. If you want a finished senior title handed to you on day one, this isn't it. If you want to EARN one, keep reading.



ABOUT THE WORK

We run our business on internal operating systems — the same repeatable pattern (data masters, dashboards, review queues, health checks, logs, automations) running across several ventures. The core is built in Google Sheets + Apps Script, and it connects out to the tools we run the business on: HubSpot (CRM/pipeline), QuickMail (cold
), Quo (voice/SMS), Slack (team + alerts), and Stripe (payments). Our engineering lives in GitHub. It all works and it's good — but it was built piece by piece, it's not standardized, and it's not in version control (Git/clasp). Right now the founder is the only person who fully knows how it all runs. Your job is to change that.



Important boundary: This is our INTERNAL operations layer. It is NOT the customer-facing product — that's engineering's world. You won't write product features. You WILL own how the internal machine runs, connects, and ships.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Standardize our systems: take the best version of each pattern (queues, logs, health checks, automations) and make everything match it. Solve it once, not five times.

- Own the connections between tools: data flows out to HubSpot / QuickMail / Quo, and signals (opens, replies, deal outcomes, payments) flow back to our systems, all keyed to one identity. Keep those adapters clean and swappable.

- Get our Apps Script into clasp + Git and own the versioning/release (DevOps) process.

- Run the daily rhythm: work the review queues, watch the health-check alerts, keep everything clean and current so the founder is out of daily operation.

- Read across systems to catch duplication and broken handoffs before they cause problems. You're the person who notices "wait, we already built this."



WHO YOU ARE (this matters more than your résumé)

- You SURFACE PROBLEMS. You hit something broken, confusing, or duplicated and you raise it — WITH a recommendation, not just a complaint. You can't walk past a mess. This is the #1 trait we're hiring for.

- You're CURIOUS FIRST, then honest. You understand WHY something exists before proposing to change it, then you say the true thing directly.

- You're PROACTIVE. You fill your own queue. Nobody should have to tell you what to work on.

- You TEACH YOURSELF. If you don't know a tool yet but you'll have it down in two weeks, that counts.



WHAT YOU NEED TO START

- Advanced Google Sheets.

- Can read and write Apps Script (JavaScript) — enough to fix a function, edit a config, set up a trigger, connect an API, and run a change carefully.

- Comfortable working with tools like HubSpot and connecting APIs between systems.

- Familiar with Git, OR a fast learner who will pick up Git + clasp quickly.

- The character above — especially the instinct to catch problems and bring a fix.



BONUS (not required — these move you toward the senior end of the pay range faster)

- MySQL / SQL databases.

- Laravel / PHP.

- Experience connecting or automating between SaaS tools (HubSpot, Stripe,
/SMS APIs, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.).

- Any DevOps / CI / deployment experience.

We're heading toward an owned platform (MySQL + Laravel) over time — if you can grow into that, this seat grows a lot.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. The word "APEX" at the top of your application (so I know you read this).

2. A short description of an internal system, tool, or automation you built — in Google Sheets/Apps Script, or connecting tools like HubSpot/Stripe/APIs — what problem it solved and how you built it.

3. One time you noticed something was broken or being done inefficiently, and what you did about it.



Applications without these three things won't be reviewed. There is a short test as part of hiring.
salary: $7–$8/hour to start, grows with proven s

title: Short-Form Producer: Own Reels/TikTok/Shorts. Ship 2–3/Day. Grow What Works, Kill What Doesn’t.
description:

If you love short-form content, have a sharp creative eye, and want a high-rep, high-feedback role where you’re judged on volume, performance, and improvement, this is for you.



What You’ll Do

   >>> 40 Shorts/Reels (20–35s, 9:16, captions, text?first opening)

   >>> 12 Carousels

   >>> 12 Static image posts

- Review performance weekly and help choose which hooks and formats we double down on.

- Spend ~30 minutes/day engaging with comments, DMs, and local Vancouver accounts following our engagement SOP.



Run the system.

- Follow our content workflow.

- Keep folders, names, and trackers updated so anyone can follow your trail.



Who You Are

- You’ve grown social accounts before and can show numbers (views, saves, subs, followers, etc.).

- You understand short-form: hooks, pacing, retention, packaging.

- You’re comfortable being measured on:

    >>> Output (how much you ship),

- You have 1+ years of content creation experience and a portfolio.

- Bonus: you’re fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut templates, Runway, etc.



Results You’ll Drive

- Hit our 28-day volume gate consistently.

- Grow monthly views beyond our current ~200,000+ across platforms.

- Improve average watch time and completion on Reels.

- Increase saves+shares per 1,000 impressions.

- Help generate inbound, content?sourced inquiries.

- Keep the content calendar tight and the library organized.



Tools You’ll Use

- CapCut

- Canva / Hootsuite

- Google Workspace, Slack

- AI tools for scripting, ideation, and analysis (ChatGPT, etc.)



Location & Compensation

- Remote

- Full-time contractor (40 hours/week)

- Base + performance-based bonus tied to content performance and consistency (discussed in detail in later stages).

- Initial 90-day evaluation period with clear targets and feedback.



Why Join Us

- Umbrella Property Services is a values?driven company built on Simplicity, Teamwork, Adventure, Results, and Sustainability.

- We believe in:

   >>> Clear expectations

   >>> High output

   >>> Honest feedback

   >>> Building systems that scale



We already average ~175,000 views/month on Instagram and 200,000+ across platforms. If you want a high-rep role where you can get very good, very fast – and you see minimums as a floor, not a ceiling – we want to talk. 



Our Hiring Process

title: Video Editor & Digital Designer
description:
Join a mission-driven team creating faith-inspired artwork seen by millions worldwide. We're looking for a Video Editor and Digital Designer who can take raw content and turn it into compelling short-form videos that stop the scroll and drive action — and who also has the design chops to create polished product imagery and prepare files for print. 



A Note Before You Apply 

We receive a lot of applications. We are not looking for someone who sends the same application to 200 jobs a day. We are looking for one person who reads carefully, follows instructions completely, and takes their craft seriously. If that's you, keep reading.



Who We Are 

Our mission is to declare the truth of God's Word through artwork. The original artwork that started our brand is called 'God's Fingerprint' and was created in 2011. Since then, we've sold over 300,000 art prints to customers in 50+ countries and reached millions through our website and social platforms. We're a small, focused team guided by three values: Christ-centered, Integrity, and Excellence. We've donated over $250,000 to Alongsiders International, which disciples orphans and vulnerable children through local churches worldwide. You'll work directly with the founder, and your work will be seen by hundreds of thousands of people. 



The Role 

We need someone who thinks about the first three seconds, keeps retention high, and knows how to make a viewer stop scrolling and feel something. You'll take raw content and scripts and turn them into videos that perform. Alongside video, you'll handle design production — product imagery, lifestyle mockups using AI tools, and preparing print-ready files. If you're strong at both and care deeply about the quality of your work, we want to hear from you. 



What You'll Be Doing 



Video 

• Use provided assets and scripts to produce short-form video content that stops the scroll and drives action 

• Think intentionally about hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, and CTAs on every video 

• Work from templates and brand guidelines while bringing creative instincts to every edit 

• Create Reels and carousel content using Scripture-based quotes and branded visuals 

• Repurpose and resize video content for
 ads and other placements 



Design & Production 

• Create polished, launch-ready product photos for new artwork releases 

• Build lifestyle mockups using AI tools and Photoshop 

• Prepare print-ready files in Photoshop and Illustrator with close attention to detail and spec 

• Adapt and resize assets across website,
, and ad placements 



Who You Are 

• Strong video editing skills with a performance mindset — hooks, retention, pacing, and CTAs 

• Solid Photoshop and Illustrator skills for production work and print file preparation 

• Experience using AI tools to create lifestyle and product imagery 

• Detail-oriented, self-directed, and able to manage multiple deliverables without hand-holding 

• Practicing Christian with a genuine love for Scripture-based content and sees the greater purpose behind it

• Preferred: experience with AI image tools (Higgsfield, Midjourney), DTC e-commerce, or interest in
/CRO strategy 



Tools You'll Use 

Photoshop & Illustrator | CapCut or Instagram Edits | AI tools (Higgsfield, Claude, or similar) | Shopify 



Compensation 

• $10-15/hour to start, based on experience — higher rate for an exceptionally strong candidate 

• 15-20 hours per week, with real potential to grow into a full-time role 



How to Apply 



We are not accepting generic applications. To be considered, please include the following numbered responses:



1. Briefly describe your most relevant experience and how it prepares you for this role. If you have a portfolio or examples of your work, please include them here. 



2. Our mission is to "declare the truth of God's Word through artwork." Does this resonate with you? If so, share why.



3. Why do you want to work as a Video Editor and Digital Designer with God's Fingerprints specifically? 



4. What year was our original artwork 'God's Fingerprint' created? 



Applications submitted without answers to all four questions will not be considered.

title: Operations Manager — Coaching Program (AI & Automation Knowledge Required) | Long-Term, Full-Time
description:
[CLOSING SOON] 



If you're looking for a job where someone tells you what to do each morning, this isn't it. We already have people who can hand out tasks. What we don't have is someone who looks at how we run, sees what's broken, and fixes it before anyone asks.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — save yourself the application.



Who we are

We're Digital Kairos. We run Brick by Brick, a cohort-based coaching program that helps consultants, coaches, and business owners build their brand and get clients on LinkedIn. Members join in classes of about 30, do daily homework, hit milestones, get on teaching calls, and lay bricks — literally, we mail them one.



We're a small remote team, mostly US-based, and we move fast. Our members pay real money and they get real results, and the reason that works is that the operations behind them are tight. Right now those operations run on people remembering things. We want them to run on systems.



That's your job.

-------------------



What you'll actually do:

Run the machine. Every cohort has a rhythm: applications come in, people get approved, they pay, they get onboarded, they get channels and access, they do homework, they hit milestones, they unlock calls, they graduate, some move up to our next-level program. You own all of it, start to finish, for every member. Nothing slips through.



Build the machine. This is the part that matters most. Right now too much of the above happens by hand — 30 individual messages sent one at a time, progress counted manually across 30 channels, recordings uploaded one by one. You'll use Claude, Zapier, and whatever else works to automate it, so the next class costs us less time than the last one. We already have a list of things waiting to be built. You'll add to it.



Organize us. Our team lives in Slack and we're mid-migration into Notion. Things live in three places and belong in one. You'll bring structure — clean systems, written processes, one source of truth — and hold us to it.



Take care of our members. You'll message our members more than anyone else on our team does. When someone falls behind, you notice. When someone's confused, you fix it before it becomes a complaint. When someone wins, you catch it and make sure it gets celebrated. This part isn't admin work — it's the experience people paid for.



Tell us what's happening. Over-communicate. Every week we want to know what shipped, what's at risk, what you noticed, and what you're changing. If you go quiet, we assume something's wrong.



-------------------



Your first 90 days

So you know this is a real job with real work waiting, here's some of what's actually sitting on the list:



- Write the cohort rulebook — every deadline, threshold, and unlock in one document, so nobody has to ask again

- Automate our application and onboarding flow (it's been on our list since June)

- Fix a broken Zapier automation between our contract and invoicing tools

- Automate our milestone messages, which are currently sent by hand, one member at a time

- Build a dashboard that shows who's behind, replacing manual counting

- Write our offboarding process, which currently exists only in people's heads



-------------------



What you need to have

- 2+ years running operations for a cohort program, membership, mastermind, online course, or coaching business. You've done this specific kind of work, not adjacent work.

- Slack at an admin level — channels, user groups, workflows, permissions

- Notion as a builder — you make databases and views, you don't just fill them in

- Zapier or Make — you've built multi-step automations with conditional logic, and you've debugged one that broke at a bad time

- AI as a daily tool. We run on Claude. You should already be using AI to do your actual work, not experimenting with it on the side. If you've set up projects, custom instructions, or recurring automated tasks, say so.

- Skool, Zoom, Calendly, Google Workspace — or the confidence to be fluent in a week

- Excellent written English. You'll write messages that go directly to our paying members. We need to trust you to hit send.

- Availability that overlaps US business hours — roughly 9AM–5PM US Central, which is about 10PM–6AM Philippine time. Being straight with you: this is a night shift. Please only apply if that genuinely works for your life.





-------------------



Nice to have

- Dashboard building, other no-code tools, experience writing SOPs for a team that had none, experience running two cohorts at once.



Pay and growth

- $1,200 USD/month, full-time

- 90-day review with a clear path to $1,500/month — tied to documenting the cohort playbook and shipping two working automations, not to a calendar date

- Quarterly performance bonus tied to member completion rates and automations shipped

- 13th month pay

- Paid time off and Philippine holidays

- This is a long-term role with room above it. As we grow, this seat grows — more programs, more systems, and eventually people to lead. We're hiring someone to build a career here, not to fill a gap.



-------------------



What working with us is like

We're direct and we move fast. We'd rather you try something and get it wrong than wait for permission. If you're stuck for more than an hour, ask — but come with what you already tried.



We don't micromanage, and we don't want to. The tradeoff is that we need you to be the kind of person who doesn't need it. For the first 30 days a teammate will review your member-facing messages while you learn our voice. After that, you send them yourself.



----------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

Read this carefully. We're using it to filter, and most applications will not make it past this section.



1. Subject line. Use exactly this, filling in the blank with your favorite automation tool:

Brick by Brick Ops — [your favorite automation tool]



2. In your message, answer these two questions. Keep it short — a few sentences each. We care about specifics, not polish.



Q1. Tell us about one workflow you automated. What tool did you use, what broke, and what did you do about it?

Q2. Here's a real situation. You have 30 members. Nine of them are behind on homework. There's a teaching call in four hours, and the rule for this week's homework requirement isn't written down anywhere. What do you do in your first hour — and what would you build so this never happens again?



3. Record a 2-minute Loom and paste the link. We watch all of them, and we can tell when it's the same video sent to fifty companies. Answer these three, in order:



- Who are you and what do you do now?

- Show us how you actually use AI in your work. Don't describe it — share your screen and walk us through something real you built or use.

- What made you apply to THIS ROLE specifically? And tell us one thing you'd change about how we've described the role, or something you noticed we might be getting wrong.



Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THE LOOM FORMAT won't either. 



-------------------



What happens next: if your Loom lands, we'll send you a short practical exercise — about an hour, using a real (anonymized) week from our program. Then one conversation with our founder and our Head of Community, then an offer. We move quickly.



We're excited to meet you. Please only apply if you read all of this — we'll know.

title: META Lead Gen Specialist — Roofing
description:
Full-time · Remote (outside the US) · Gorilla Ads, a division of Gorilla Brands



You check cost per lead before breakfast. You have been making other companies' phones ring for years, and you are still treated like a task-doer, handed a login and a budget and told not to touch anything else.



We are looking for the opposite of that. Someone we can respect, trust, and hand the seat to.



Gorilla Brands is a performance marketing agency built for roofers. Gorilla Ads is our paid ads division, and it is the division we are building right now. We are not an agency that learned roofing from a webinar. We run our own roofing company doing over 8 million a year in retail work, and the Meta system you would inherit is the one that feeds it every single day, with our own money on the line. It works, and we have the numbers to prove it.



But we are not looking for someone to babysit it. We are looking for someone good enough to take what is working, make it better, and expand it. Our goal is to help roofers win, and the person in this seat is a big part of how we get there. You own it, you improve it, and you help us build it into the best roofing ad engine in the country.



Now we are taking that to roofers across the country, and the Meta buying seat inside Gorilla Ads is yours.



DOES ANY OF THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

- Running so many ad accounts you cannot do your best work on any of them?

- Great at buying media, tired of hunting for your next client?

- Working hard for a company that pays you as little as it can get away with?

- Sitting in a job where "this is how we have always done it" is the answer to everything?

- Just want a real, long-term seat where good work gets noticed and the tools are actually good?



If even one of those is you, keep reading.



WHO WE ARE



Gorilla Brands exists to help roofers win. That is the whole point. We go deeper on one industry than any generalist agency ever could, and we beat them on every front: the offer, the creative, the landing pages, the follow-up, the automation. It is not close, and we can prove it.



We run on five values, and we hire and fire on them:



- Own It. If the number is down, it is ours until it is fixed. Your number is our number.

- Protect the Spend. Every dollar of budget gets guarded like it is our own money on the line.

- Be the Gorilla. Out front and dominant. We go further than the average agency, every time.

- Speed Wins. Fast to answer, fast to launch, fast to fix. Slow is losing.

- No BS. You always know what we are doing, where every lead came from, and what it cost.



The last line matters most for this seat. We refuse to settle for the industry status quo. Average is not in us. If you are the kind of person who looks at any task and asks "how could this be done better, and can AI do it," you will fit here. If you are comfortable running things the way they have always been run, you will not.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You help roofers win by running their Meta ads. That is the job. You are running and maintaining 15 to 20 roofing accounts at once, and every one of them is counting on you to make the phone ring.



- Build and launch. Set up the campaigns for each account and get them live.

- Manage daily. Open every account each day. Check the spend, the leads, and the cost. Move budget to what is working, cut what is not, and line up the next tests. You work through this with your creative strategist, so you are never guessing alone.

- Work with your team. You are not a one-person show here. A creative strategist works alongside you to turn what the data is telling you into new ads and pages, and a designer, editor, and tech team build them. You d
 what the accounts need and where to push. If you want to get in and build something yourself, go for it, but you will never have to.

- Report every week. Send each client a clean report: spend, leads, appointments, and cost per appointment. Get on a call and explain it in plain English.

- Own the number. The goal on every account is the same: booked appointments with homeowners who want a new roof. That number is yours to hit. When it is good, that is you. When it is down, you find out why and fix it.



WHY THIS SEAT IS DIFFERENT

- You would run a system that already wins, not a science experiment. The offers, the conversion sequences, the self-learning targeting, all of it is built and proven on our own roofing company before it ever touches a client.

- A full team behind you. You run the ads. They build. You are never the designer, the editor, and the buyer all at once again.

- One industry to master. Roofing, deep, instead of twelve industries an inch each.

- Top-of-market pay, named below. Not "competitive."

- A real green light on AI. Here it is the mandate, not a rule you break quietly.

- Ground floor of something being built, backed by a company that already succeeded.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Proven Meta lead gen results you personally produced. You will walk us through real accounts, numbers on the screen.

- Lead gen experience specifically. Ecommerce-only buyers will not qualify, no matter how strong.

- You know the difference between a cheap lead and a lead that books and sits, and you can talk about it for an hour.

- Strong spoken English and real comfort on camera.

- Self-managing. You run accounts without daily hand-holding.

- An AI-first instinct. You already reach for AI to do the work better, and you can show us how.

- The capability to run 15 to 20 live accounts with weekly reporting as the engine scales.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Every account hits its appointment target, and you can prove it.

- Weekly reports ship without a single reminder.

- Leadership is out of the ad accounts, because you have them.

- Your creative strategist gets clear direction from you on what the data says to build next, not "make more ads."

- Account count scales without quality slipping.



COMPENSATION

₱100,000 -> ₱200,000 per month depending on experience and proof, deliberately set at the top of the market for this role. We would rather pay one great buyer top-of-market than three average ones.

title: Community Coordinator - Phone + Leasing Enquiries for a US Housing Community (Night shift, US Central hours) - Long-term
description:
ABOUT US

We own and operate Hometown Meadows, a 40-acre residential community in Nashville,

Arkansas. Stocked fishing pond, playground, dog park, on-site laundry. Real families

live here, and how they are treated on the phone is most of their first impression

of us. We are a small US company. You would be one of about eight people.



THE ROLE

You are the voice of our community. You answer the phone, help residents, and turn

enquiries from people looking for a home into booked showings for our operations

manager. When the phone is quiet, you go out and create the next call - posting

available homes and keeping our online presence active.



You will report directly to Zo, and Dane our operations manager on site in Arkansas.



DAY TO DAY

- Answer the community phone line on Dialpad. Warm, patient, unhurried.

- Take enquiries from people looking for a home. Answer their questions about

  availability, rent, pets, and the application, and book them a showing.

- Log every maintenance request and route it to the operations manager.

- Take payment questions and pass them on. You will not negotiate anything.

- Return every voi
 and text the same shift. No message sits overnight.

- Keep a simple call log so we can see what people are calling about.



WHEN THE PHONE IS QUIET - THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART

This is not a job where you sit and wait. On a slow day you:

- Post and refresh our available homes on
 Marketplace, MHVillage,

  Craigslist and our Google Business Profile.

- Publish scheduled posts and photos from our marketing folder.

- Reply to comments and messages on our listings and social pages.

- Keep listing photos, prices and availability accurate and current.



All templates, photos, logos and captions are provided. You will have a written

content plan so you always know what to post next. You will not be waiting on

anyone for instructions.



WHO WE WANT

- 2+ years on the phone with US customers. Property management, hospitality,

  healthcare scheduling or inbound customer service all count.

- Clear, warm, easily understood spoken English. Neutral accent. You sound like a person, not a script.

- Genuine patience. Some callers are stressed about money or a broken water

  heater. You stay kind.

- Comfortable posting listings and basic social content from templates.

  Canva experience is a plus, not a requirement.

- You solve small problems yourself and ask about big ones. If you need someone

  to tell you what to do every hour, please do not apply - you will be unhappy.

- Reliable power and internet, and a quiet place to take calls. 



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

- You do not chase people for money or negotiate payment arrangements.

- You do not approve applications or make promises about repairs.

- You do not answer housing-assistance or fair-housing questions from memory.

  We give you an approved answer sheet, and anything not on it goes to Zo.

  We will train you on this properly in your first week.



SCHEDULE - PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a NIGHT SHIFT. Our community is in the US Central time zone.

- Your hours: 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday.

  (That is 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM in Arkansas.)

- One hour paid break inside the shift.

- We pay above market because we know what a night shift costs you. If the

  schedule does not fit your life, please do not apply - we want someone who

  is still here in two years.



COMPENSATION

TBD depending on experience. Paid twice monthly.

Bonus of USD 25 for every showing you book that becomes a signed lease.

We are looking for a long-term teammate, not a temporary one.





HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW EVERY STEP

Applications missing a step are not read.

1. Begin your message with the word: MEADOWLARK

2. Record a 60-second voice message (any recorder, send a link) where you:

   - introduce yourself, and

   - pretend I am a caller asking "do you have any 2-bedroom homes

     available, and how much?" Answer me the way you would answer a real

     caller. You do not need to know our real prices - make them up.

3. In writing, 3-5 sentences: it is a slow night, the phone has not rung in

   three hours, and nobody has given you a task. What do you do?

4. Confirm you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time.

5. Describe your internet speed and where in your home you would take calls.

title: AI Video Creator, UGC & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT
description:
AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT

Create health and wellness reels and UGC videos.



I run a fast-growing
 and Instagram health and wellness brand built around a consistent AI avatar, along with a growing network of additional social media pages.



I am looking for an **experienced AI video creator and editor** who can take a script and turn it into high-quality, realistic short-form content from start to finish.



**This is NOT a training role.**



You should already be comfortable working with the tools below and be able to start producing quality content with minimal hand-holding.



The three biggest things I care about are:



* **Following instructions exactly**

* **Making the videos look as realistic as possible**

* **Communicating clearly and consistently**



If I provide a reference video, avatar image, product image, editing example, or specific instructions, I expect those details to be followed closely.



## TOOLS YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW



### Veo 3 / Google Flow / Capcut / Elevenlabs



You should know how to:



* Generate high-quality, photorealistic AI videos from written prompts

* Create realistic human movement, expressions, gestures, and speech

* Maintain consistent characters between clips

* Create vertical short-form content ready for Instagram and

* Match the pacing, camera angles, movements, and overall feel of reference videos

* Troubleshoot poor generations and improve prompts without needing constant guidance



### Veo3 / Nano Banana



You should have strong experience with:



* Nano Banana 1

* Nano Banana 2

* Nano Banana Pro

* Veo3 

* Google Flow image generation and video generation

* Elevenlabs

*Capcut



You should understand when to use each model depending on the task.



You must be able to generate **hyper-realistic images** while maintaining:



* Consistent facial identity

* Accurate clothing

* Accurate products

* Realistic hands

* Realistic skin texture

* Natural lighting

* Correct proportions

* Consistent environments



The goal is for viewers to have difficulty immediately recognizing that the content is AI-generated.



### ElevenLabs



You should know how to:



* Generate realistic voiceovers

* Maintain the same voice across multiple clips

* Control pacing, tone, emotion, and delivery

* Make the voice match the avatar

* Avoid robotic or inconsistent speech



**Voice consistency between clips is extremely important.**



### CapCut



You should be highly comfortable editing short-form vertical content in CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Match a reference video's editing style closely

* Add and style captions

* Match fonts, placement, sizing, and timing

* Sync music properly

* Remove dead space

* Create tight cuts

* Color correct footage

* Match pacing

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS

I will often provide very specific instructions about:

* Camera angles

---

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description:
Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator



We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects.



The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework.



Primary Responsibilities



* Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements.

* Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication.

* Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts.

* Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs.

* Determine the number of slabs required for each project.

* Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities.

* Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity.

* Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required.

* Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication.

* Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers.

* Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation.

* Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements.



Required Experience



* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD.

* Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform.

* Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry.

* Ability to read architectural and structural plans.

* Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations.

* Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts.

* Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software.

* Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer.

* Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation.

* Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus.

title: Video Editor + GoHighLevel / AI Systems VA — Multi-Brand (Reels, Graphics, Automations)
description:
JOB TYPE / SALARY FIELDS

Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week)

Salary: $1,100 – $1,500 USD/month, depending on skill

Hours: 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday (This is 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM US Eastern. It is an early-morning Manila shift, not a graveyard shift.)

JOB DESCRIPTION (paste into the body)

About us



We own and operate several businesses in Indianapolis, Indiana. Two of them will be most of your work:



24 Shelby — a wedding and event venue. The content here is emotional and cinematic: first looks, the dress, the room at golden hour, a father crying during the toast.

Cash Car Heroes — a car buying service. People sell us their cars for cash. The content here is the opposite: fast, direct, punchy, built on trust and clarity. Very different brand, very different edit.



You'll work across these and our other businesses. We have a full-time, very talented videographer capturing footage — you are not sourcing content, you are turning a steady stream of professionally shot material into finished posts.



This role does not involve answering phones. You will not be on calls. This is heads-down creative and systems work.



What you'll do



Video editing — Reels & TikTok (the biggest part of the job)



Take raw footage from our videographer and cut it into short-form vertical video: Reels, TikToks, Shorts

Find the moment in 40 minutes of footage that makes someone stop scrolling

Strong hooks in the first 1.5 seconds, clean pacing, beat-matched cuts

Accurate, well-styled captions/subtitles on every video

Use trending audio and trending formats — and know what's trending this week, not last year

Color-correct so everything looks as good on screen as it does in person

Switch cleanly between brand voices. A wedding Reel and a car-buying Reel should not feel like the same video with different clips in it. Different pacing, different music, different energy, different hooks. This is the skill we're really hiring for.

Deliver consistent weekly volume across all brands



How delivery works: you edit, we post. You will not have access to our social accounts and you are not responsible for scheduling, posting, or replying to comments and DMs. Your job ends when finished, export-ready files land in our shared drive — correctly named, correctly sized, and ready for us to publish as-is without touching them.



Graphics & photo touch-ups



Build and maintain on-brand Canva templates for each business — they should not look like each other

Color, crop, straighten and clean up photos

Carousel posts, story graphics, pricing and offer graphics

Resize and reformat everything correctly for each platform

Deliver a suggested caption and hashtag set alongside each video — we may use it, edit it, or write our own, but we shouldn't have to start from a blank box



GoHighLevel — build, not just click around



Build and maintain automation workflows across our businesses: lead capture, missed-call text-back, appointment reminders and confirmations, no-show follow-up, review requests, long-term nurture sequences

Set up and maintain pipelines, stages, triggers, tags and custom fields for each business

Build calendars and booking flows

Create
 and SMS campaigns and templates

Build a workflow once, turn it into a snapshot, deploy it to the next business — we want you finding the leverage, not rebuilding the same thing three times

Build reports and dashboards so we can see what's working per business

Find what's broken and fix it without being asked twice



AI



Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to draft captions,
s and SMS copy at volume — then edit them so they don't sound like AI wrote them

Set up and train GHL Conversation AI to answer inbound leads after hours

Use AI image and video tools where they genuinely help

Bring us ideas. If there's a tool that would save us ten hours a month, we want to hear about it.

What we require

2+ years editing short-form vertical video. CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut — we don't care which, we care about the output. You must have real Reels or TikToks you personally cut that we can watch.

Range. You can edit something emotional and you can edit something that sells. Most editors can do one. We need both.

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You have built workflows inside GHL yourself — not watched a course about it. You should be able to walk us through something you built and explain why you built it that way.

Real AI tool fluency. You use AI daily, you know how to prompt it properly, and you know when its output isn't good enough to ship.

Canva, and ideally Photoshop or Lightroom

Good written English — you're writing captions and customer-facing SMS/email copy, so it has to read naturally to an American

Genuine taste. You can look at two versions of an edit and know which one is better and why.

Organized enough to juggle several brands without mixing them up

Reliable internet (25 Mbps+), a computer that can actually edit 4K video without crawling, and a backup connection

Able to work 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM Manila, Monday–Friday, consistently

Self-directed. You'll get footage and a deadline, not a shot list.

Nice to have (not required)

Experience working across multiple brands or in an agency

Wedding, event, automotive or local-service content experience

Motion graphics / After Effects

Zapier or Make

Experience building a GHL snapshot from scratch

What we offer

$1,100 – $1,500 USD/month, paid twice a month

Full-time, long-term, stable — we want to build something with one person, not cycle through five

Paid time off after 90 days, and US + PH holidays observed

A professional videographer feeding you good footage — you will never be asked to make something out of nothing

Real creative ownership. If your edits perform, we'll follow your instincts.

We'll fund tools you need — editing software, stock, AI subscriptions

Direct work with the owner, no layers in between

Room to grow as we add businesses

HOW TO APPLY (this is the screening filter — keep it exactly as written)



Read carefully. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject line. Use this exact subject line:



SHELBY REELS – [Your Full Name]



Step 2 — Send 3 short-form videos you personally edited. Links, not files. Reels, TikToks or Shorts.



At least one must be emotional or lifestyle. At least one must be for a business trying to get customers. We are specifically looking at your range.



For each one, tell us in a single sentence: what was your role, and what did you d
 about the edit that someone else might not have?



Do not send a "showreel" or a portfolio site full of work you didn't cut. Three specific videos, edited by you.



Step 3 — Prove the GoHighLevel experience. Record a short Loom (2–3 minutes) screen-sharing a workflow, pipeline or automation you built inside GHL. Walk us through what it does and why. Blur or hide any client information.



If you genuinely cannot show a GHL account, record yourself explaining in detail one automation you built and exactly how you set it up, step by step. We will be able to tell the difference between someone who built it and someone who read about it.



Step 4 — One question, answered in 3–4 sentences.



On Monday morning our videographer hands you two folders: 45 minutes from a wedding on Saturday, and 20 minutes shot at our car-buying lot. Both need to be posted this week. Walk us through what you actually do — and tell us what you'd need from us to make them good.



Step 5 — Include:



Your speedtest.net result

Your computer specs (processor, RAM, and what editing software you run)

Confirmation that you can work 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM Manila, Monday–Friday

Your expected monthly rate in USD



Paid test edit: Finalists will be paid for a real test edit using our actual footage before we hire. We don't ask anyone to work for free.



We review applications daily and reply to everyone who completes all five steps.

title: Transportation Tracker – Local Operations
description:

This is a hybrid operations role, as local execution may vary from day to day and additional OTR tracking or operational support may be assigned when local activity is limited.



Role Overview

You will help coordinate the daily movement and activities of our local drivers. Your primary focus is to ensure drivers are continuously moving, scheduled tasks are completed efficiently, operational issues are communicated to the appropriate teams, and all required documentation is completed before drivers leave pickup or delivery locations. You will work closely with U.S. Operations Leads to coordinate local executions, prioritize assignments, and handle ad-hoc operational needs throughout the shift. Because local volume may fluctuate, you should also be comfortable supporting OTR tracking and other transportation operations tasks when there are no immediate local executions.

• Track driver locations, load progress, ETAs, pickups, deliveries, and other milestones while keeping TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms accurate and up to date.

• Work closely with U.S. Operations Leads to coordinate local executions, ad-hoc tasks, and operational issues involving trucks, trailers, equipment, loads, or service concerns.

• Ensure required paperwork, receiver signatures, status updates, and timestamps are completed, and proactively follow up or escalate delays, missing information, or time-sensitive issues.

• Support OTR tracking when local activity is limited and maintain organized documentation and complete shift handoffs for pending drivers, loads, and operational issues.



What Success Looks Like

• Local drivers stay productive, receive clear next assignments, and avoid unnecessary downtime.

• Daily local tasks are scheduled, prioritized, and completed efficiently.

• Truck, trailer, paperwork, and service issues are identified early and communicated to the appropriate team.

• Load data, tracking platforms, and delivery paperwork remain accurate, complete, and up to date.

• OTR support and shift handoffs are handled effectively when local activity is limited.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, trucking, dispatch, transportation tracking, or fleet operations preferred

• Understanding of local fleet coordination, dispatch operations, load tracking, and Hours of Service

• Familiarity with U.S. geography and U.S. trucking operations is a plus

Role Overview

Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

title: Trailer Repair Specialist
description:
GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery.



If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation.



Role Overview

You are responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution.



The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending.



What You’ll Be Doing



Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination

• Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors.

• Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step.

• Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations.

• Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team.

• Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending.



Fleetio and Data Integrity

• Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift.

• Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current.

• Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information.

• Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible.



Off-Tour Trailer Operations

• Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up.

• Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team.

• Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements.

• Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability.

• Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.



Documentation and Morning Handoff

• Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift.

• Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups.

• Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation.

• Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff.

• Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.



What Success Looks Like

• Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution.

• Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift.

• Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs.

• Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions.

• The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination.

• Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred.

• Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation.

• Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Long term and full time remote independent contractor role

• Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO

• Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required

• Zoom presence with camera on throughout the shift is required

• Time tracking software, including Hubstaff or another platform, may be implemented as operationally required



What You’ll Get

• Independent contractor setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning 30 days after hire

• Reliable biweekly payments

• A stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based

• Direct exposure to a live US transportation and fleet operation

• Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity

• Opportunities to develop deeper experience in Trailer Management, fleet maintenance, repair coordination, and transportation operations

• Potential growth within Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, or broader logistics operations



This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning.

title: Distressed Property Research Analyst
description:
We buy distressed property in Florida. Most of our leads come from county delinquent tax lists. This job is working through those lists one property at a time, looking each one up in the county records, and telling us which ones are worth our attention.

The list goes on a 
 board, one property per row. For each one you are building a fact pattern: what happened to this property and the people who own it, from the county records, with the documents to back it up.

You start in the county Official Records. The list already tells you the taxes are unpaid, so that is not the signal. If nothing in the records suggests a problem, there is no fact pattern to build. You score it poorly and move on. A lot of rows end there.

When something is there, you keep pulling until you have the picture: every document that is part of the story downloaded and attached to the row, who owns it on paper and how they got it, court records for probate and divorce and judgments, heirs researched through obituaries and other tools if an owner has died, and skip tracing on the people who would have to sign.

What we want at the end is a short account of what happened, the documents that show it, and a note on what you could not determine. We train you on all of it.

We buy all property types. Houses, land, mobile homes, small commercial.

You will not contact owners. You will find phone numbers, but you will not call them. No sales, no offers.

Preferred: paralegal, title, or real estate experience. Not required. Strong written English is required.

The most important thing: we need someone who will write "I could not find this" instead of guessing. We make decisions based on what you write.

About 15 hrs/week, flexible schedule, paid weekly, ongoing. 

To apply, answer these: (1) Something difficult you had to track down and how you did it. (2) Any experience with deeds, court records, or contracts. (3) What you do when a long list starts to blur together. Paid one-hour exercise for anyone who gets past this stage.

MINIMUM SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS



Computer

📌 Operating System: Windows 10 / Windows 11 or latest macOS.

📌 CPU: Windows: Intel i5 (8th Gen+) or AMD Ryzen 5+; Apple/MacBook: Intel i5+ or Apple M1 chip or newer (M2, M3, etc.).

Internet, Primary Connection

📌 Download and Upload: Minimum 85 Mbps each, verified via live speed test at the IT System Check.

📌 Type: DSL or Fiber.

📌 Ownership: home-owned/in-house DSL, Fiber, or Cable.

Backup Power

📌 Acceptable Sources: gas or diesel generator; high-powered inverter (at least 300 watts, laptops only); or a heavy-duty power bank (minimum 120,000 mAh, laptops only).

📌 Duration: must power both computer and internet for 8 to 9 hours to cover a full shift during outages.

title: UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission
description:
UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission



Build your career with a fast-growing UK brand—not just another VA job.



Are you confident on the phone, naturally good with people and motivated by achieving great results?



Do you want to work with a company that values your contribution, supports your development and gives you the opportunity to grow into a long-term career?



Care Claim Line is a growing UK customer support business helping older people and their families understand and access support they may be entitled to.



We are now expanding our operations and building our Philippines-based FRT team. We are looking for ambitious, professional and customer-focused Filipino team members who want to be part of something bigger than a standard freelance role.



This is your opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company, join a supportive international team and help build the customer experience as our business continues to expand.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



This is a professional, phone-based B2C customer qualification role for someone who enjoys meaningful conversations, takes pride in helping customers, loves working towards targets and wants to be rewarded for strong performance.



Most importantly, this is not a cold-calling role.



Every customer you contact has already opted in, made an enquiry or requested that Care Claim Line contact them. You will be speaking with people who are expecting to hear from us and have already shown an interest in finding out more.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



You’ll speak with UK customers who have made an enquiry with us or specifically asked to be contacted, then guide them through our initial qualification process.



Your role will include:



• Making outbound calls to UK customers who have opted in or requested contact

• Speaking confidently, warmly and professionally with older customers

• Creating a positive first impression of Care Claim Line

• Following our structured qualification process

• Asking thoughtful questions and listening carefully to each customer

• Understanding the customer’s situation and identifying whether they may be suitable for our service

• Completing customer information accurately in our system

• Passing qualified customers to our UK sales team

• Following up with customers when required

• Working towards clear daily and weekly KPIs

• Contributing ideas and feedback as our Philippines operation develops



You will never be expected to cold-call random or purchased lists.



The people you contact will already have engaged with Care Claim Line and asked to hear from us. Your role is to respond promptly, build trust, understand their needs and help them take the next step.



You are not responsible for completing the full customer application.



Your job is to make the customer feel listened to, qualify them accurately and create a high-quality handover to our UK team.



WHY JOIN CARE CLAIM LINE?



This is more than a remote calling job.



You’ll be joining a growing UK company at an exciting stage of its development. We are building our Philippines team from the ground up, which means the people who join us early will have the opportunity to make a real impact and grow alongside the business.



You’ll work with a team that values energy, professionalism, accountability and a great customer experience.



We want our team members to feel proud of the work they do, supported by the people around them and excited about where the company is going.



As we expand, high-performing team members will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, support new starters, help improve processes and progress into senior, training and team leadership positions.



If you are ambitious, reliable and ready to build something with us, this could be the beginning of a long-term opportunity—not just another online job.



WHO WE WANT



We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in:



UK B2C outbound sales

UK call centres / BPO

Lead qualification

Appointment setting

Telesales

Customer service

Inbound enquiries and warm outbound follow-up

CRM systems and diallers



Previous experience speaking with UK customers is highly desirable.



Experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or callback requests is especially valuable.



Please note that this is fundamentally different from cold calling. Customers have already expressed interest and are expecting contact from the business.



We’re looking for someone who is:



Confident and engaging on the telephone

Warm, friendly and naturally personable

Excellent at spoken English

Easy for UK customers to understand

Patient and respectful when speaking with older customers

A strong listener who can ask the right questions

Competitive and motivated by targets

Reliable, punctual and professionally presented

Comfortable following structured processes

Accurate when recording customer information

Open to feedback and committed to improving

Motivated by commission, progression and long-term growth



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position working UK business hours, so please make sure you are comfortable working the corresponding Philippines hours before applying.



You’ll work remotely from the Philippines as part of our wider UK customer team.



We value professionalism, consistency and communication, while also understanding the benefits of working remotely. You’ll have the flexibility of a home-based role while being part of a structured, supportive and ambitious international team.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



You’ll receive:



• Full training and ongoing support

• A clear and structured call process

• Professional cloud phone and customer management systems

• Existing opted-in customer enquiries and callback requests to contact

• UK management and support

• Regular feedback and coaching

• Clear performance targets

• Base pay plus performance-related earning opportunities

• The opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company

• A supportive team culture built around professionalism and development

• Opportunities to progress as our Philippines operation grows

• The chance to help shape and build our FRT team from the beginning



We’re not looking to build a team of temporary freelancers.



We’re looking for people who want to grow with the company.



As the Philippines operation expands, there will be opportunities for high performers to progress into senior, training and team leadership positions.



The people who join us early will have the chance to help shape how the team works, support future colleagues and become an important part of Care Claim Line’s growth story.



IMPORTANT – VOICE SAMPLE REQUIRED



The quality of your spoken English is extremely important for this position.



When applying, please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your outbound/BPO experience.

2. Details of any experience working with UK customers.

3. Details of your experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or customer callback requests.

4. Your previous sales or qualification KPIs, if you know them.

5. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a strong fit for Care Claim Line.

6. Your expected hourly or monthly base salary.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and a short mock customer call based on a warm customer enquiry.



We’re recruiting a small initial team now, with plans to expand significantly based on performance.



If you’re confident on the phone, naturally good with people, motivated by results and excited by the opportunity to help build a growing UK company’s Philippines operation, we’d love to hear from you.



Join us early. Grow with us. Help shape what comes next.
