title: Finance & Bookkeeping Assistant — Agency & Personal Finances (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
I run a UK-based creative agency working with e-commerce brands spending millions per month on ads. I need a detail-oriented finance assistant to manage both my business finances and personal finances. You'll be the person who keeps track of every dollar coming in and going out, makes sure payments are processed on time, and gives me clear visibility on my financial position at all times.



This role is part bookkeeper, part financial analyst, part personal finance manager. If you love spreadsheets, cashflow forecasting, and making sense of messy numbers — this is for you.



What You'll Do:



Business Finance:



Track all agency income across multiple clients — retainers, percentage of spend invoices, and any other revenue

Track all business expenses — editor payments, strategist payments, software subscriptions, tools, and operational costs

Calculate monthly profit and loss per client and for the agency overall

Process payments to editors, strategists, and contractors via Revolut Business (you will be added as a Team Member)

Send client invoices via Revolut Business and track payment status

Chase outstanding invoices and flag overdue payments

Calculate monthly editor payroll based on output data provided by the operations team

Maintain a clean, up-to-date financial dashboard in Google Sheets showing revenue, expenses, profit, and cash position



Personal Finance:



Track all personal income and spending across bank accounts and credit cards

Categorise every personal transaction weekly — food, dining, travel, rent, subscriptions, entertainment, transport, clothing, health, etc.

Create visual spending breakdowns — pie charts or bar charts showing where money is going each month

Flag areas where spending is too high and recommend where to cut back

Track personal net worth monthly — bank balances, investments, assets, debts

Help set and monitor monthly personal budgets



Cashflow & Forecasting:



Maintain a rolling cashflow forecast — what's coming in over the next 30, 60, 90 days based on client contracts and expected payments

Flag any upcoming cash crunches before they happen — e.g. if a big invoice hasn't been paid and payroll is due

Forecast monthly income based on current client retainers and projected ad spend percentages

Track progress towards financial targets and goals — I'll share my targets and you tell me if I'm on pace or falling behind

Model scenarios — e.g. "if I sign 2 more clients at $10K, what does my monthly P&L look like after team costs?"



Reporting:



Send a weekly financial summary every Monday — total income, total expenses, net position, outstanding invoices, upcoming payments due

Send a monthly financial report — full P&L, spending breakdown, personal vs business analysis, progress towards targets, cashflow forecast update

All reports should be visual and easy to read — charts, colour coding, clear summaries. Not walls of numbers



Requirements:



Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills — formulas, charts, pivot tables, conditional formatting, dashboards

Experience with bookkeeping, financial tracking, or management accounting

Excellent attention to detail — every number must be accurate, every transaction categorised correctly

Reliable and consistent — the weekly report must arrive every Monday without being chased

Good written English for clear communication

Comfortable handling sensitive financial information with complete confidentiality

Proactive — if you see a problem in the numbers, flag it immediately, don't wait for me to ask

Comfortable learning new tools — you will be using Revolut Business to process payments and send invoices



Strong Preference For:



Experience working with agencies, freelancers, or small businesses managing multiple income streams

Experience with Revolut Business, Stripe, Xero, or QuickBooks

Experience with cashflow forecasting and financial modelling

Experience managing multi-currency finances (USD, GBP, EUR)

Ability to create clean, visual financial dashboards and reports



Working Hours:



Flexible, but must be available for a weekly 15-minute check-in call during UK business hours (9am-5pm GMT/BST). Weekly report due every Monday by 12pm UK time. Monthly report due by the 3rd of each month.



How to Apply:



Please reply with:



A short intro — who you are, your background in finance or accounting, and why this role is a good fit for you

Your highest qualification in accounting or finance

Describe your experience tracking finances for a business or individual — what tools did you use and what did you report on?

A link to or screenshot of any financial spreadsheet, dashboard, budget tracker, or P&L you have created (can be anonymised)

Your experience with Revolut Business or similar payment platforms

Your expected monthly salary in USD

Your available working hours in UK time



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test task ($15). I will send you a sample bank statement and business transaction data. You will need to categorise everything, build a spending breakdown with charts, calculate a basic P&L, and write a short analysis with recommendations.

title: DREAM MEDICAL CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR!
description:
SYNERGY RISING ~ Job Ad: DREAM CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR



Medical Claims Submission & Reimbursement Tracking Support Pretty Please



Are you a detail-obsessed, heart-led VA who actually ENJOYS medical paperwork? Does a clean, color-coded, perfectly-tracked spreadsheet make your whole day better?



Do you have experience with insurance billing, medical bookkeeping, claims submission, or medical records... and do you understand that ACCURACY here is not a nice-to-have, it is everything?



If you said YES, please read on!



WHO I AM



Hello, brilliant soul!



I'm Kama, RN and Nurse Coach, founder of Synergy Rising LLC and host of the Dancing With Dementia™ & Caregivers Rising™ Podcast. I've spent over 20 years in healthcare, and years now caregiving for my mom. My work centers on empowering young, young-at-heart, and atypical caregivers through coaching, holistic tools, and real talk.



We are in a BIG launch season... a new website, our signature membership, and a growing podcast... and I need a steady, meticulous person to take one very important piece off my plate so I can keep building.



WHAT THIS WORK ACTUALLY IS



Here is the honest heart of it, so you know exactly what you'd be stepping into...



This is supplemental insurance claim submission and reimbursement tracking for a family navigating a long health journey while caring for a sick loved one. Years of records, real benefits that were paid for and never claimed, and money that belongs back in the hands of the family caring for someone they love.



Doing this work well does TWO beautiful things at once... it helps a caregiving family recover what is rightfully theirs, AND it directly funds a service-based company launching resources for caregivers everywhere.



Because this involves private medical information, this role requires a signed NDA and a signed agreement to follow HIPAA guidelines. That is a HARD gate ~ nothing begins until that is complete. Full details are shared after signing, not before.



The role in one line: read medical records carefully, identify every claimable benefit, build and maintain a clean claims tracker, prepare and submit claim forms, and track every submission through to payment.



A note on the team: this is a TEAM. You'll work with me directly, and alongside my EA and the rest of our crew, so clear communication and collaboration are part of the magic.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



FIND the money. Read through years of medical records and spot every visit, procedure, radiology exam, lab, and service that is claimable... then cross-reference each one against what the policy ACTUALLY covers, and how many times per year it can be used.



TRACK it beautifully. Keep our Google Sheets tracker current and self-calculating... policy coverage on one tab, the claims log on the other. Formulas do the counting, never you.



BUILD the claim. One clean supporting-documentation PDF per claim, a completed claim form with every single field filled, and file names matched to our exact standard format... no improvising, no "close enough."



SEND it and log it. Fax each claim as it is finished, one at a time, never saved up in a batch... then log the submission, the payment, and the amount, so we ALWAYS know what is still owed.



FLAG what looks off. A number that does not match, a benefit you are unsure about, a date that does not line up. Flagging beats guessing, ALWAYS.



THE ACCURACY THING (please read closely)



A wrong number here quietly becomes a wrong claim. A mislabeled benefit quietly becomes a denial. A sloppy file name quietly becomes an hour of somebody's life spent looking for a document.



So I need someone who slows down where it counts, double-checks their own work before it reaches me, and treats "I verified it against the source document" as the standard, not the exception.



We start with ONE complete claim, start to finish, reviewed together... so if anything is off, we catch it after ONE claim instead of after forty!



WHO YOU ARE



~ EXCELLENT digital organization... this is a MUST-have, not a nice-to-have. Folder structures, file naming conventions, version control, and a system you can hand to someone else and have them understand it instantly



~ Comfortable reading medical documentation... visit notes, itemized bills, EOBs, procedure and diagnosis language



~ Confident in Google Sheets... formulas, filters, and building something that stays accurate on its own



~ Meticulous with numbers, dates, and matching wording EXACTLY



~ Discreet and trustworthy with private information, always



~ Willing to sign an NDA and follow HIPAA guidelines



~ Organized, proactive, and resourceful... you find answers and ask great questions



~ Warm, reliable, and genuinely kind (this is a heart-forward brand and team)



~ Strong English skills for clear written communication



~ A consistent, reliable internet connection



~ Excellent with follow-through and feedback



~ Able to provide references



BONUS GLOW (nice, not required)



~ Direct experience with insurance billing, medical billing, or medical bookkeeping



~ Familiarity with supplemental / voluntary benefit policies (AFLAC-type a
, hospital, wellness, and disability benefits)



~ Experience working with EOBs, claim forms, denials, appeals, or timely-filing rules



~ Medical coding exposure (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS)



~ Experience with PDF tools, merging, redaction, and online fax services



~ Caregiving lived experience or a heart for this mission



THE LOGISTICS



~ Rate: $3 per hour to start, with ROOM TO GROW as the company grows! PLEASE VERIFY THIS FEELS ALIGNED BEFORE YOU APPLY!



~ This begins as a GIG ~ one focused project, with a clear finish line



~ AND ~ if you are excellent, communicative, and a joy to work with, there is real possibility to grow into an ongoing seat with Synergy Rising and Affiliates on other projects.



~ Hours: FLEXIBLE ~ work whenever works for YOU, as long as deadlines are met and communication stays clear



~ Start: immediately, beginning with ONE complete claim as a paid trial



~ Fully remote



TO BE CONSIDERED



Please reply with "DREAM CLAIM & DETAILS SAVIOR!" in your subject line, and answer these questions. You can apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph, or
 me directly at 
 answer in your OWN words. I am reading for how you think and how you explain... not for perfect textbook definitions.



1. A short intro about you and your experience... especially with insurance billing, medical billing, medical bookkeeping, medical records, or claims work of any kind.



2. In plain language, as if you were explaining it to a patient: what is the difference between an EOB and an itemized bill? Which one tells you what was actually PAID?



3. What do CPT and ICD-10 codes each describe, and why does it matter that they match up on a claim?



4. A claim comes back DENIED. Walk me through the first four things you would check, in order.



5. Here is a scenario... the policy document says a benefit pays $200 and can be used twice per year. Your tracker shows it was already submitted twice this year, but only paid once. What do you do next, and what do you tell me?



6. Show me your DIGITAL ORGANIZATION. How do you name files, structure folders, and keep track of a large multi-year project so nothing gets lost? Screenshots or examples are very welcome!



7. What is your experience level in Google Sheets? Tell me about a tracker or system you have built.



8. How do you handle private and confidential information? Have you signed an NDA or worked under HIPAA guidelines before? Are you comfortable doing both here?



9. Have you ever submitted claims by FAX or used an online fax service? Which one?



10. You are unsure whether a service qualifies under a policy. What do you do... and how do you communicate that to me?



11. How do you like to receive and act on feedback? Tell me about a time you took a note and made something even better.



12. WHY does this work matter to YOU? What draws you to a mission built around caregivers?



13. Are you good with starting at $3/hour, with the goal of GROWING with us?



14. Can you provide references? Please have them ready.



15. Bonus: any experience with coaching, health, or wellness brands, memberships, or online courses?



Let's build something meaningful, heart-centered, and wildly impactful... together! And if you know someone who'd be a great fit, please send them our way.



When one rises, we all rise.

title: UGC Manager
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO -> Systems Architect | Team Leader | Luxury Fashion
description:
We are an ambitious international luxury fashion brand looking for an exceptional operator to become the CEO’s strategic right hand.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role. You will design the systems, lead the teams and build the operational infrastructure behind our next stage of global growth—from CRM, ERP and ClickUp to Shopify, B2B, D2C, logistics and payment control.



We move fast, challenge conventions and expect relentless follow-through.



High standards. Complete transparency. No corner-cutting.



Your Mission



Turn complexity into control.



You will create one connected operational system across CRM, ERP, Shopify, Klaviyo, ClickUp, Hubstaff, inventory, finance and logistics—then ensure every team member uses it correctly.



You will not simply manage operations. You will build an operation capable of scaling 10x.



What You Will Own



Systems Architecture



* Evaluate HubSpot versus GoHighLevel and select the right CRM for our business.

* Build the CRM structure, pipelines, automations, reporting and customer journeys from scratch.

* Connect CRM, ERP, Shopify, Klaviyo, ClickUp and other operational platforms.

* Create scalable systems for B2B, D2C, inventory, customer communication and management reporting.

* Identify inefficiencies before they become problems.



Team Leadership & Accountability



* Lead international operational, administrative and commercial teams.

* Set clear responsibilities, deadlines, KPIs and reporting standards.

* Follow up relentlessly and ensure commitments become results.

* Use Hubstaff to monitor hours, activity and productivity.

* Address underperformance immediately—no hidden hours, no excuses and no unfinished follow-up.



B2B & D2C Operations



* Manage wholesale orders, distributors, international clients and B2B communication.

* Improve the B2B ordering, invoicing, payment and fulfilment process.

* Oversee and optimize our Shopify D2C operation.

* Build and manage Klaviyo
 and SMS campaigns, flows and customer segments.

* Maintain a consistent luxury brand experience across every channel.



ERP, Inventory & Logistics



* Build, optimize and maintain the ERP infrastructure supporting B2B and D2C.

* Coordinate suppliers, factories, 3PL partners and international logistics providers.

* Maintain accurate inventory, order and fulfilment data.

* Ensure every order is tracked from purchase through payment, production and delivery.

* Prevent operational details from falling through the cracks.



Negotiation & Financial Follow-Up



* Negotiate pricing, payment terms and service levels with suppliers, 3PLs, logistics partners and key vendors.

* Protect margins and secure commercially strong agreements.

* Control invoice follow-up, payment collection, reconciliations and operational cash-flow visibility.

* Escalate risks early and arrive with solutions.



Executive Partnership



* Operate as the CEO’s strategic and operational right hand.

* Anticipate needs instead of waiting for instructions.

* Convert fast-moving ideas into clear priorities, owners, systems and deadlines.

* Prepare decisions, challenge weak thinking and drive execution.

* Bring structure to chaos without slowing down the business.



Who We Are Looking For



You are not an average assistant. You are a high-level operator who can combine strategic thinking with ruthless execution.



You have:



* Proven experience leading teams and holding people accountable.

* Strong B2B, wholesale and D2C e-commerce experience.

* Deep Shopify and Klaviyo knowledge.

* The ability to assess, build and scale HubSpot or GoHighLevel.

* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, NetSuite, Odoo, Uphance or similar systems.

* Advanced ClickUp skills, including dashboards, workflows and automations.

* Confidence using Hubstaff for transparent productivity management.

* Strong negotiation skills with suppliers, vendors and international partners.

* An instinctive understanding of luxury fashion, aesthetics and customer experience.

* The ability to work across European, US and Asian time zones.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication.

* The discipline to take complete ownership from problem to result.



You do not simply use software. You understand how systems, teams and commercial channels must work together.



You are sharp, confident, articulate and style-conscious. You may have tattoos, an unconventional aesthetic or a provocative edge—but your execution is disciplined, professional and uncompromising.



You can charm a luxury client, negotiate with a factory and hold an international team accountable—all on the same day.



Non-Negotiables



* This is an exclusive, full-time position.

* No parallel jobs, freelance work, side businesses or concurrent clients.

* Your complete professional working capacity must be committed to this role.

* Quarterly travel to Hong Kong is required: four trips per year of approximately ten days each.

* Occasional travel to New York, Los Angeles or Miami is optional but valued.

* Core availability will be aligned with European operations, with flexibility for US and Asia-Pacific communication.

* Integrity, transparency and follow-through are absolute requirements.



What We Offer



* A full-time remote leadership position.

* Direct partnership with the CEO.

* Competitive compensation.

* Genuine authority and influence over how the company operates.

* The opportunity to build our global infrastructure from the ground up.

* Full coverage of approved international travel expenses, including flights, hotels, meals and personal presentation requirements.

* Exposure to international luxury fashion, trade shows, showrooms and global partners.

* A clear path toward a C-suite role as the company scales.



How to Apply



Send the following immediately via WhatsApp:




Include:



* Your CV, including relevant achievements.

* Examples of systems you have built, teams you have led and measurable results you have delivered.

* A two-to-three-minute introduction video explaining who you are, why you are right for this position and what attracts you to luxury fashion operations.



Start your WhatsApp message with:



“I’M TROUBLE”



This confirms that you have read the complete vacancy and understand the level of commitment expected.



We review applications on a rolling basis and move quickly when we meet the right person.



The brand name and full company details will be shared with selected candidates during the interview process.

title: Inbound + Outbound Phone VA
description:
Phone VA for US Car-Buying Company — Graveyard Shift, Dedicated Role, Raise + Commission at 90 Days

We are Cash Car Heroes. We buy cars from people across Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and Illinois — both junk vehicles and cars that still run and drive. Someone calls us with a car they want gone, we make an offer, and we send a truck. Simple business, steady phones.



We're hiring one phone VA, and this is a dedicated position — you work Cash Car Heroes and nothing else. No jumping between brands, no admin side projects. Your entire shift is the phone. You'd be the voice of the company for most people who call us.

What you'll actually do all shift

Answer inbound calls from people wanting to sell a vehicle — junk, non-running, or a car that still drives fine

Speak to every caller within 5 minutes. This is our core promise and it's non-negotiable. If a call comes in while you're on another one, you call that person back inside five minutes. Not twenty. Five.

Gather vehicle info accurately — year, make, model, mileage, does it run, does it drive, title status, condition, location

Present the offer we provide and handle the normal objections ("that's too low," "let me think about it")

Schedule pickups and coordinate with our US-based drivers by text

Outbound follow-up on every lead that didn't close — most of our money is in the second and third call

Log everything in our system so nothing falls through

Schedule — read this part carefully

Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday

9:00pm to 6:00am Manila time (this is 9am–6pm US Eastern)

30-minute lunch, scheduled at the same time every shift so phone coverage is predictable

Wednesday and Sunday off — you get a full rest day mid-week, which most graveyard roles don't give you

42.5 paid hours/week, long-term, this is not a short project

Hours are tracked in Time Hub. You clock in, clock out, and clock your lunch.



If overnight work isn't something you can do consistently for the next year, please don't apply. We'd rather you tell us now.

Pay

$4.00 USD/hour for your first 90 days

$5.00 USD/hour at 90 days

Plus commission/incentive pay starting at 90 days — you earn on top of your hourly, not instead of it. Structure is set with you based on your numbers.

Paid [weekly / every two weeks] via Wise, based on Time Hub records

Paid holidays after 6 months: [confirm or delete]



At 42.5 hours/week, $5.00/hr puts you at roughly $920/month — and that's your floor once commission starts, not your ceiling.

Where this goes if you're good

We're being upfront: $4/hr is a starting number, not a ceiling. This is a growing company with several brands under it, and we'd rather grow someone than keep rehiring.



At 90 days — hourly goes to $5.00, and commission/incentive pay starts on top of it

Beyond that — the person who owns these phones well is the person we look to first when we need a lead VA to train the next hire, or someone to take on dispatch and operations work

Across the business — Cash Car Heroes is one of several brands we run. People who prove themselves on one set of phones get first look at what opens up elsewhere.



If you're looking for a seat you can stay in and grow out of, this is that. If you're looking for a stopgap until something better comes along, we'd rather you keep looking — the training investment doesn't make sense for either of us.

What we need from you

Non-negotiable:



Clear, neutral, easy-to-understand English on the phone. Americans on the other end are often stressed, older, or calling from a noisy driveway. They need to understand you the first time.

Stable internet — minimum 25 Mbps, with a backup (pocket wifi or mobile data)

Your own computer, 8GB RAM minimum

A USB headset with a boom microphone. Not earbuds, not your laptop's built-in mic. If you don't have one yet, tell us — we'll help.

A quiet place to work. No roosters, no karaoke, no family in the background.



What makes you stand out:



Previous BPO, call center, or US-client phone experience

Any exposure to cars, auto parts, towing, insurance, or dispatch

Sales or collections background — you're comfortable asking for the yes

You can stay warm and human on the call without reading a script like a robot

How your performance is measured

We keep this simple and visible. You'll know exactly where you stand:



5-minute response time — every caller spoken to inside five minutes, every shift

Complete intake — year, make, model, mileage, runs/drives, title status, location captured on every call

Follow-up completed — no lead sits untouched

Attendance — graveyard only works if you're reliably there



Hit these for 90 days and your raise and bonus conversation happen on schedule.

Tools we use

OpenPhone for calls and texts, Time Hub for time and attendance, Google Sheets for lead logging. We'll train you on everything. You don't need to know them already.

How to apply — follow this exactly

Applications that skip any step get deleted without reading. This is the first test.

title: Virtual Assistant – Calls, Leads & Tour Booking for US Wedding Venue + Uncapped Commission (Excellent Spoken English Req
description:
JOB TYPE / SALARY FIELDS

Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week)

Salary: $1,100 – $1,400 USD/month, depending on experience

Hours: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time, Monday–Friday (This is 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Eastern. It is a night shift. Please only apply if you can work these hours long-term.)

HOW TO APPLY (this is the screening filter — keep it exactly as written)



Read this carefully. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject line. Send your application with this exact subject line:



SHELBY TOURS – [Your Full Name]



Step 2 — Record a Loom video (60–90 seconds). Go to 
 (free), turn on your camera and microphone, and record yourself answering these three questions out loud:



Tell us about yourself and your experience with US clients.

Why do you think you'd be good at talking to couples planning their wedding?

Tell us about a time a customer was upset with you. What did you say to them?



Speak naturally. Do not read from a script — we can tell, and we're listening for how you sound in a real conversation. Paste the Loom link in your application.



Step 3 — Answer this in writing.



A bride sends this Instagram DM at 4:40 PM on a Friday:



"hi! is 24 shelby available october 10 2027? also whats your pricing, we have about 150 people. my fiance and i are looking at a few venues this weekend"



Write the exact reply you would send her. Just the reply — no explanation of your thinking, no "here's what I would do." Write it as if you are sending it to her right now.



Step 4 — One more short answer.



In 3–4 sentences: if we handed you a list of 50 Indianapolis companies and told you to get their holiday party booked at our venue, what would your first week look like? We're not looking for a perfect answer — we want to see how you think about outbound.



Step 5 — Include:



Your internet speed test result (screenshot or link from speedtest.net)

Confirmation that you can work 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time, Monday–Friday

Your expected monthly rate in USD



We review applications daily and reply to everyone who completes all five steps.

title: Amazon Store Manager
description:
Amazon FBA Account Manager – UK Store



Experienced Applicants Only | Remote | Long-Term



About the Role

We are an established UK Amazon FBA seller specialising in consumer electronics. We need an experienced Amazon Account Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day store, protect profitability and make sure operational issues do not slip through the cracks.



This is not a beginner VA or product-uploading role. You must already be confident using Amazon Seller Central and managing an FBA account independently.



Main Responsibilities



Manage the Amazon UK store day-to-day, including Seller Central issues, cases and account messages.



Monitor Buy Box performance and manage Revboard while protecting our minimum ROI/profit targets.



Use Sellerboard to monitor sales, COG, fees, refunds, ROI and net profit.



Review ASIN performance and identify profitable fast sellers to reorder, including recommended quantities.



Identify slow-moving, low-ROI or loss-making products and recommend reducing or stopping them.



Monitor inventory, stranded/suppressed listings and FBA stock issues.



Manage FBA shipments and labels when required.



Monitor high-value returns/refunds (£200+) and make sure every unit is accounted for.



Trace returned units through FBA Customer Returns, IDR and Inventory Ledger where required.



Raise and chase eligible Amazon reimbursement claims for missing/lost/damaged inventory.



Arrange or recommend removal of defective/customer-damaged stock where appropriate.



Provide a simple weekly report covering sales, profit, ROI, reorders, poor ASINs, returns, reimbursements and open issues.



Who We Are Looking For



Minimum 3 years of hands-on Amazon FBA / Seller Central experience.



Strong understanding of Buy Box, ROI, margin, COG, Amazon fees and profitability.



Experience investigating FBA returns, lost inventory and reimbursements.



Sellerboard experience strongly preferred.



Revboard experience strongly preferred; other repricer experience is useful.



Keepa and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills are advantageous.



Able to investigate and solve problems independently without constant instructions.



Good written English, organisation and communication.



Please Do Not Apply If

You are new to Amazon, your experience is mainly product uploading/data entry, you have never managed FBA reimbursements, or you need training on normal Seller Central tasks.



How to Apply – Screening Questions

Start your application with: FBA-262



Then answer the questions below. Applications that skip these questions will not be reviewed.



1. How many years have you personally managed Amazon FBA Seller Central accounts, and which marketplaces?



2. What was the approximate monthly revenue of the largest Amazon account you helped manage?



3. What have you used Sellerboard for?



4. Have you used Revboard? If not, which repricers have you managed?



5. How would you d
 whether an ASIN should be reordered? Which metrics would you check?



6. A £350 FBA product was refunded 50 days ago. It has not returned to sellable inventory and no reimbursement is visible. Explain step-by-step how you would investigate it.



7. Give one real example of an FBA reimbursement or inventory issue you personally investigated and resolved.



8. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time role?



Important: We are looking for someone who can tell us what happened, why it happened, the financial impact, and what action they took — not someone who simply downloads reports. Generic or obviously AI-generated applications that do not demonstrate genuine Amazon experience will not progress.



Monday to Friday - 5ours per day (10am to 3pm) UK time - $4 per hour

We sell industrial tools, torque and hydraulic equipment, safety products, high-voltage equipment, workwear, rigging products and specialty supplies. We also provide calibration, repair and equipment-rental services.

Candidates must have experience supporting B2B websites with customer hierarchies, including parent companies, locations, company administrators, buyers, purchasing permissions and approval workflows.



This is not a basic product-upload, virtual-assistant or Shopify-only position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working with BigCommerce theme code, APIs, custom applications, integrations and B2B functionality.



This is a long-term employment opportunity structured as an independent-contractor arrangement. The successful candidate will be treated as a valued member of our company and included in relevant team communications, planning and decision-making. This person will work directly with the company’s owners, have meaningful responsibility for our e-commerce platform and play an important role in the company’s long-term growth.

title: Business Development Executive | B2B Sales | U.S. Company
description:
American Sign & Lighting is looking for an experienced Business Development Executive to help us find, develop, and win new customers in the U.S. market.



We're looking for a hunter.



Someone who is comfortable researching potential customers, picking up the phone, reaching decision-makers, starting Sales conversations, following up consistently, and turning prospects into real business opportunities.



This is not a Customer Service position, and it is not a role where you will simply wait for leads to be assigned to you.



Your job is to help create new business.



What You'll Do

Research and identify potential B2B customers.

Prospect new accounts through outbound calling and other outreach methods.

Connect with business owners, managers, and decision-makers.

Introduce our services and uncover potential business needs.

Qualify prospects and develop new Sales opportunities.

Schedule and conduct follow-up conversations.

Build relationships with prospects over time.

Maintain an active and organized Sales pipeline.

Track leads, conversations, follow-ups, and opportunities in the CRM.

Help move opportunities through the Sales process toward closing.

Re-engage prospects who have gone cold.

Consistently look for new ways to generate business.



What We're Looking For:

You should have previous experience in one or more of the following:

Business Development | B2B Sales | Outbound Sales | Account Executive | Sales Development | Lead Generation



We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate:

Strong outbound prospecting experience.

Confidence making Sales calls.

Experience selling to U.S. customers or businesses.

Ability to speak professionally with decision-makers.

Experience generating your own leads or identifying target accounts.

Strong follow-up and pipeline management.

CRM experience.

Measurable Sales results.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Persistence, organization, and self-motivation.



Closing experience is a strong advantage.





This Is More Than Cold Calling.

Yes, outbound calling is an important part of the job. But we're not looking for someone whose only goal is to hit a call number.

We want someone who understands the bigger picture:

Find the right prospect → Start the conversation → Identify the opportunity → Follow up → Build the relationship → Move the opportunity forward → Win business.



If you've spent your career generating appointments but have never been responsible for what happens afterward, this may not be the right opportunity.



Who Will Succeed Here?

Someone who doesn't need to ask: "Who should I call next?"



Instead, you think: "Where can I find the next customer?"

You're resourceful, persistent, comfortable with rejection, and motivated by creating opportunities and producing results.



Compensation:

$1,000–$2,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience.



We are willing to invest in experienced Sales talent who can demonstrate the ability to generate meaningful business opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.



Schedule:

title: Senior QuickBooks Online Accountant

* Balance sheet reconciliations beyond bank and credit card accounts

* Loans, fixed assets, AR, AP and equity accounts

title: U.S. Bookkeeping & Accounting Professional
description:
Immediate Opening



We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients.



This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying.



What the Role Looks Like



For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client.



This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume.



We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you.



However, the position will not stay this way.



We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools.



As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients.



Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities.



What We're Looking For



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have:



* Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR

* Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality

* Good written and verbal English communication skills

* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment

* An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology

* A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses



Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours.



Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying.



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them.



Where This Position Can Go



We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices.



We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role.



As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit both of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute



In your video, please briefly tell us:



* Your accounting/bookkeeping background

* How much experience you have working with U.S. clients

* The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled

* Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule

* Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients



Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.
